a: Dela katleh david leshimi, deityelid minneh mardochay demikkanne beh haman. uma shillem li yemini — dela katleh shaul laagag, deityelid minneh haman dimtzaar leyisrael.
Rabbi yochanan amar: leolam mibbinyamin kaate, veammay kare leh "yehudi"? al shum shekkafar baavoda zara. shekkol hakkofer baavoda zara nikra "yehudi", kedichtiv: "itay guverin yehudayin vegomer".

Rabbi shimon ben pazzi, ki hava patach bedivre hayyamim, amar hachi: kol devarecha echad hem, veanu yodin ledorshan. "veishto hayehudiyya yalda et yered avi gedor veet chever avi socho veet yekutiel avi zanoach veelle bene bitya vat paro asher lakach mared".
Ammay kare la "yehudiyya" — al shum shekkafra baavoda zara, dichtiv: "vattered bat paro lirchotz al hayeor", veamar rabbi yochanan: sheyyarda lirchotz miggillule bet aviha.
"Yalda"? veha rabboye rabbiteh! lomar lecha shekkol hamegaddel yatom vitoma betoch beto — maale alav hakkatuv keillu yelado.

"Yered" ze moshe, velamma nikra shemo "yered"? sheyyarad lahem leyisrael man beyamav. "gedor" — sheggadar pirtzotehen shel yisrael. "chever" — shechibber et yisrael laavihen shebbashshamayim. "socho" — shennaasa lahem leyisrael kesukka. "yekutiel" — shekkiuu yisrael lael beyamav. "zanoach" — shehizniach avonotehen shel yisrael.
"Avi" "avi" "avi" — av battora, av bechochma, av binviut.
"Veelle bene bitya asher lakach mared", vechi mered shemo? vahalo kalev shemo! amar hakkadosh baruch hu: yavo kalev shemmarad baatzat meraggelim, veyissa et bat paro shemmarda begillule bet aviha.
"Asher hogla mirushalayim", amar rava: sheggala meatzmo.

"Vayhi omen et hadassa", kare la "hadassa" vekare la "ester"? tanya, rabbi meir omer: ester shemah, velamma nikra shemah hadassa — al shem hatztzaddikim shennikreu hadassim. vechen hu omer: "vehu omed ben hahadassim".
Rabbi yehuda omer: hadassa shemah, velamma nikret shemah ester? al shem shehayta masteret devareha, shenneemar: "en ester maggedet et ammah vegomer".

Rabbi nechemya omer: hadassa shemah, velamma nikret ester? shehayu ummot haolam korin otah al shum istahar. ben azzay omer: ester, lo arukka velo ketzara hayta, ella benonit kahadassa. rabbi yehoshua ben korcha amar: ester — yerakroket hayta, vechut shel chesed mashuch aleha.
"Ki en lah av vaem" — "uvemot aviha veimmah" lema li? amar rav acha: ibberatta — met aviha, yeladatta — meta immah.

"Uvemot aviha veimmah lekachah mordochay lo levat", tana mishshum rabbi meir: al tikre "levat" ella levayit. vechen hu omer: "velarash en kol ki im kivsa achat ketanna asher kana vaychayyeha vattigdal immo veim banav yachdav mippitto tochal umikkoso tishte uvecheko tishkav vattehi lo kevat", mishshum divcheko tishkav havot leh (levat)? ella — (levayit) hachi name levayit.
"Veet sheva hannearot vegomer". amar rava: shehayta mona bahen yeme shabbat. "vayshanneha veet naaroteha vegomer". amar rav: sheheechilah maachol yehudi.
Ushemuel amar: sheheechilah kedale dachazire.
Verabbi yochanan amar: zeronim, vechen hu omer: "vayhi hammeltzar nose et pat bagam venoten lahem zeronim".

"Shishsha chodashim beshemen hammor". may "shemen hammor"? rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar: setachat, rav huna amar: shemen zayit shello hevi shelish. tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: anpakinon — shemen zayit shello hevi shelish, velamma sachin oto — shemmashshir et hassear umeadden et habbasar.
"Baerev hi vaa uvabboker hi shava", amar rabbi yochanan: miggenuto shel oto rasha lamadnu shivcho, shello haya meshammesh mittato bayyom.

"Vattehi ester noset chen", amar rabbi elazar: melammed shellechol echad veechad nidmeta lo keummato. "vattillakach ester el hammelech achashverosh el bet malchuto bachodesh haasiri hu chodesh tevet", yerach shennehene guf min hagguf.
"Vayyeehav hammelech et ester mikkol hannashim vattissa chen vachesed lefanav mikkol habbetulot", amar rav: bikkesh litom taam betula — taam, taam beula — taam.
"Vayyaas hammelech mishte gadol". avad mishteya vela galleya leh, dalli keraga vela galleya leh, shaddar pardishne vela galleya leh.
"Uvehikkavetz betulot shenit vegomer". azayl shekal etza mimmardochay, amar: en ishsha mitkannea ella beyerech chavertah, vaafillu hachi la galleya leh, dichtiv: "en ester maggedet moladtah vegomer".
Amar rabbi elazar, may dichtiv:
b: "Lo yigra mitztzaddik enav" — bischar tzeniut shehayta bah berachel zachta veyatza mimmenna shaul, uvischar tzeniut shehaya bo beshaul zacha veyatzat mimmennu ester.
Umay tzeniut hayta bah berachel? dichtiv: "vayyagged yaakov lerachel ki achi aviha hu". vechi achi aviha hu? vahalo ben achot aviha hu?

Ella, amar la: minnasva li? amara leh: in, mihu abba rammaa hu vela yachlat leh. amar la: achiv ana berammaut. amara leh: umi shere letzaddike lesaggoye berammayuta? amar la, in: "im navar tittavar veim ikkesh tittappal".
Amar la: umay rammayuta? amara leh: it li achata dekashshisha minnay vela mansev li mikkamma. mesar la simanim.

Ki meta lelya, amara: hasheta mikkasfa achatay. mesartinhu nihala. vehayeynu dichtiv: "vayhi vabboker vehinne hi lea", mikkelal dead hasheta lav lea hi? ella: mittoch simanin shemmasra rachel lelea — la hava yada ad hasheta. lefichach zachta veyatza mimmenna shaul.

Uma tzeniut hayta beshaul? dichtiv: "veet devar hammelucha lo higgid lo asher amar shemuel", zacha veyatzat mimmennu ester. veamar rabbi elazar: keshehakkadosh baruch hu posek gedulla leadam — posek levanav velivne vanav ad sof kol haddorot, shenneemar: "vayyoshivem lanetzach vayyigbahu (vegomer)". veim hegis dato — hakkadosh baruch hu mashpilo, shenneemar: "veim asurim bazzikkim vegomer".

"Veet maamar mordochay ester osa", amar rabbi yirmeya: shehayta mara dam nidda lachachamim. "kaasher hayta veomna itto", amar rabba bar lima (mishshemeh derav): shehayta omedet mecheko shel achashverosh vetovelet veyoshevet becheko shel mardochay.

"Bayyamim hahem umordochay yoshev beshaar hammelech katzaf bigtan vateresh", amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hiktzif hakkadosh baruch hu adon al avadav laasot retzon tzaddik. umannu? yosef, shenneemar: "vesham ittanu naar ivri vegomer".
Avadim al adonehen laasot nes latztzaddik, umannu? mardochay, dichtiv: "vayyivvada haddavar lemordochay vegomer".

Amar rabbi yochanan: bigtan vateresh shene tarsiyyim havo, vehayu mesapperin belashon turesi, veomrim: miyyom shebbat zo lo rainu shena beenenu, bo venattil eres bassefel kede sheyyamut. vehen lo hayu yodin ki mardochay miyyoshve lishkat haggazit haya, vehaya yodea beshivim lashon.
Amar lo: vahalo en mishmarti umishmartecha shava? amar lo: ani eshmor mishmarti umishmartecha. vehayeynu dichtiv: "vayvukkash haddavar vayyimmatze" — shello nimtzeu bemishmartan.
"Achar haddevarim haelle". (achar may?) amar rava: achar shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu refua lammakka.

Deamar resh lakish: en hakkadosh baruch hu makke et yisrael ella im ken bore lahem refua techilla, shenneemar: "kerofi leyisrael venigla avon efrayim". aval ummot haolam eno ken — makke otan veachar kach bore lahem refua, shenneemar: "venagaf Adonai et mitzrayim nagof verafo".
"Vayyivez beenav lishloach yad bemordochay levaddo". amar rava: battechilla bemardechay levaddo, ulevassof beam mardochay, umannu — rabbanan, ulevassof bechol hayyehudim.
"Hippil pur hu haggoral", tana: kevan shennafal pur bechodesh adar samach simcha gedola, amar: nafal li pur beyerach shemmet bo moshe. velo haya yodea shebbeshiva baadar met, uveshiva baadar nolad.

"Yeshno am echad", amar rava: lekka deyada lishshana bisha kehaman. amar leh: ta nichallinhu. amar leh: mistefena meelahayhu dela lebed bi kedaavad bekammae. amar leh: ["yeshno" —] yashnu min hammitzvot.
Amar leh: it behu rabbanan. amar leh: am echad hen.

Shemma tomar, karcha ani ose bemalchutecha — mefuzzarin hem ben haammim. shemma tomar: it hanaa minnayyhu — "meforad", kifreda zo sheenah osa perot. veshemma tomar, ikka medinta minnayyhu — talmud lomar: "bechol medinot malchutecha".

"Vedatehem shonot mikkol am", dela achli minnan vela nasvi minnan vela minnasvi lan. "veet date hammelech enam osim", demappeki lechulla shatta beshihe pihe. "velammelech en shove lehannicham", deachlu veshatu umevazzu leh lemalka, vaafillu nofel zevuv bechoso shel echad mehen — zorko veshotehu, veim adoni hammelech nogea bechoso shel echad mehen — chovto bakkarka veeno shotehu.

"Im al hammelech tov yikkatev leabbedam vaaseret alafim kikkar kesef vegomer", amar resh lakish: galuy veyadua lifne mi sheamar vehaya haolam sheatid haman lishkol shekalim al yisrael, lefichach hikdim shiklehen lishkalav.
Vehayeynu ditnan: beechad baadar mashmiin al hashshekalim veal hakkilayim.
"Vayyomer hammelech lehaman hakkesef natun lach vehaam laasot bo kattov beenecha", amar rabbi abba:

a: Mashal daachashverosh vehaman lamma haddavar dome? lishne bene adam, leechad haya lo tel betoch sadehu uleechad haya lo charitz betoch sadehu. baal charitz amar: mi yitten li tel ze bedamim! baal hattel amar: mi yitten li charitz ze bedamim!
Leyamim nizdavvevgu ze etzel ze. amar lo baal charitz levaal hattel: mechor li tillecha! amar lo: tol oto bechinnam, vehalevay!

"Vayyasar hammelech et tabbato", amar rabbi abba bar kahana: gedola hasarat tabbaat yoter mearbaim ushemona neviim vesheva neviot shennitnabbeu lahen leyisrael, shekkullan lo hechezirum lemutav, veillu hasarat tabbaat hechziratan lemutav.
Tanu rabbanan: arbaim ushemona neviim vesheva neviot nitnabbeu lahem leyisrael, velo pichatu velo hotiru al ma shekkatuv battora, chutz mimmikra megilla.
May derush? amar rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha: uma meavdut lecherut amrinan shira — mimmita lechayyim lo kol shekken.
I hachi, hallel name nema! lefi sheen omrim hallel al nes shebbachutza laaretz. yetziat mitzrayim, denes shebbechutza laaretz, hechi amrinan shira?
Kidtanya: ad shello nichnesu yisrael laaretz — hucheshru kol aratzot lomar shira. mishshennichnesu yisrael laaretz — lo hucheshru kol haaratzot lomar shira.
Rav nachman amar: keriyyaytah zo hallelah. rava amar, bishlama hatam: "halelu avde Adonai" — velo avde faro, ella hacha: "halelu avde Adonai" — velo avde achashverosh? akkatti avde achashverosh anan.
Ben lerava ben lerav nachman kashya, veha tanya: mishshennichnesu laaretz — lo hucheshru kol haaratzot lomar shira! kevan sheggalu, chazru lehechsheran harishon.
Vetu lekka? vehachtiv: "vayhi ish echad min haramatayim tzofim", echad mimmatayim tzofim shennitnabbeu lahem leyisrael.
MiAdonai tuva havo, kidtanya: harebe neviim amdu lahem leyisrael, kiflayim keyotze mitzrayim. ella nevua shehutzercha ledorot — nichteva, veshello hutzercha — lo nichteva.

Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: adam habba mishte ramot shetztzofot zo et zo. rabbi chanin amar: adam habba mibbene adam sheomdin berumo shel olam. uman ninhu? bene korach, dichtiv: "uvene korach lo metu", tana mishshum rabbenu: makom nitbatztzer lahem begehinnam, veamdu alav.

Sheva neviot man ninhu? sara, miryam, devora, channa, avigayil, chuleda veester. sara, dichtiv: "avi milka vaavi yiska", veamar rabbi yitzchak: "yiska" zo sara, velamma nikra shemah yiska — shessachta beruach hakkodesh, shenneemar: "kol asher tomar elecha sara shema bekolah". davar acher: "yiska" — shehakkol sochin beyofyah.

Miryam — dichtiv: "vattikkach miryam hannevia achot aharon", velo achot moshe, amar rav nachman amar rav: shehayta mitnabbea keshehi achot aharon, veomeret: atida immi shetteled ben sheyyoshia et yisrael. uveshaa shennolad nitmalle kol habbayit kullo ora, amad aviha uneshakah al roshah, amar lah: bitti nitkayyeyma nevuatich.
Vechevan shehishlichuhu layor, amad aviha utefachah al roshah, veamar lah: bitti hechan nevuatich? hayeynu dichtiv: "vattetatztzav achoto merachok ledea". ladaat ma yehe besof nevuatah.
Devora, dichtiv: "udevora ishsha nevia eshet lappidot", may "eshet lappidot"? shehayta osa petilot lammikdash.

"Vehi yoshevet tachat tomer". may shena tachat tomer? amar rabbi shimon ben avshalom: mishshum yichud. davar acher: ma tamar ze en lo ella lev echad — af yisrael shebbeoto haddor lo haya lahem ella lev echad laavihen shebbashshamayim.

Channa — dichtiv: "vattitpallel channa vattomar alatz libbi baAdonai rama karni baAdonai". "rama karni", velo rama pakki. david ushelomo shennimshechu bekeren — nimshecha malchutan, shaul veyehu shennimshechu befach — lo nimshecha malchutan.

"En kadosh chaAdonai ki en biltecha", amar rav yehuda bar menashsheya: al tikre "biltecha", ella "levallotecha". shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vedam. middat basar vedam — maase yadav mevallin oto, aval hakkadosh baruch hu — mevalle maase yadav.

"Veen tzur kelohenu", en tzayyayr kelohenu. adam tzar tzura al gabbe hakkotel veeno yachol lehattil bah ruach uneshama, keravayim uvene meayim. aval hakkadosh baruch hu tzar tzura betoch tzura, umetil bah ruach uneshama, keravayim uvene meayim.
Avigayil, dichtiv: "vehaya hi rochevet al hachamor veyoredet beseter hahar". "beseter hahar"? "min hahar" mibbee leh!
Amar rabba bar shemuel: al iske dam habba min hassetarim. natla dam veherata lo. amar lah: vechi marin dam ballayla? amra lo: vechi danin dine nefashot ballayla? amar lah:
b: Mored bammalchut hu, vela tzerich lemeddayyneh. amra lo: adayin shaul kayyaym velo yatza tivacha baolam. amar lah: "baruch tamech uverucha at asher kelitini [hayyom hazze] mibbo vedamim".

"Damim" — tarte mashma! ella melammed sheggilleta et shokah vehalach leorah shalosh parsaot, amar la: hishshami li! amra lo: "lo tihye zot lecha lefuka". "zot" — mikkelal deikka achariti, umay nihu? maase devat sheva. umassekana hachi havay.
"Vehayta nefesh adoni tzerura bitzror hachayyim", ki havot mippatra minneh amra leh: "vehetiv Adonai ladoni vezacharta et amatecha".
Amar rav nachman, hayeynu deamri inashe: itteta bahade shuta pilka. ikka deamri: shafel veazel bar avoza veenohi mittayyfi.

Chuleda, dichtiv: "vayyelech chilkiyyahu hakkohen vaachikam veachbor vegomer". uvemakom dekae yirmeya hechi mitnabbeya ihi? amri be rav mishshemeh derav: chuleda kerovat yirmeya hayta, velo hava makpid aleha.
Veyoshiyya gufeh hechi shavek yirmeya umeshaddar legabba? amri deve rabbi shela: mippene shehannashim rachamaniyyot hen.

Rabbi yochanan amar: yirmeya la hava hatam, shehalach lehachazir aseret hashshevatim. umenalan deihadur? dichtiv: "ki hammocher el hammimkar lo yashuv", efshar yovel batel, venavi mitnabbe alav sheyyibbatel? ella melammed sheyyirmeya hechziran,

Veyoshiyyahu ben amon malach alehen, dichtiv: "vayyomer ma hatztziyyun hallaz asher ani roe vayyomru elav anshe hair hakkever ish haelohim asher ba mihuda vayyikra et haddevarim haelle asher asita al hammizbach bevet el", vechi ma tivo shel yoshiyyahu al hammizbeach bevet el? ella melammed sheyyoshiyyahu malach alehen. rav nachman amar, mehacha: "gam yehuda shat katzir lach beshuvi shevut ammi".

Ester — dichtiv: "vayhi bayyom hashshelishi vattilbash ester malchut", bigde malchut mibbee leh! ella shellevashatta ruach hakkodesh, ketiv hacha: "vattilbash", uchetiv hatam: "veruach lavsha et amasay vegomer".

Amar rav nachman: la yaa yehiruta linshe. tarte neshe yehiran havyayn, vesanyin shemayyhu: chada shema zibbureta, vachada shemah karkusheta. zibbureta ketiv ba: "vattishlach vattikra levarak", veillu ihi la azala legabbeh. karkusheta ketiv ba: "imru laish", vela amra "imru lammelech".
Amar rav nachman: chuleda mibbene vanav shel yehoshua hayta — ketiv hacha: "ben charchas", uchetiv hatam: "betimnat cheres".

Etiveh rav ena sava lerav nachman: shemona neviim vehem kohanim yatzu merachav hazzona, veellu hen: neriyya, baruch, useraya, machseya, yirmeya, chilkiyya, chanamel, veshallum. rabbi yehuda omer: af chuleda hannevia mibbene vaneha shel rachav hazzona hayta. ketiv hacha: "ben tikva", uchetiv hatam: "et tikvat chut hashshani".

Amar leh: ena sava, veamri la: patya ukkama, minni uminnach tistayyem shemata: deiggayyayra venasva yehoshua. umi havo leh zara lihoshua? vehachtiv: "non beno yehoshua beno"! bene la havo leh, benata havo leh.

a: Bishlama inhu — mipparshi, ella avahatayyhu menalan?

Kidulla. deamar ulla: kol makom sheshshemo veshem aviv binviut — beyadua shehu navi ben navi. shemo velo shem aviv — beyadua shehu navi velo ben navi, shemo veshem iro meforash — beyadua shehu meotah hair, shemo velo shem iro — beyadua shehu mirushalayim.

Bematnita tana: kol shemmaasav umaase avotav setumin, ufarat lecha hakkatuv beechad mehen leshevach, kegon: "devar Adonai asher haya el tzefanya ben kushi ven gedalya" — beyadua shehu tzaddik ben tzaddik. vechol shepparat lecha hakkatuv beechad mehen lignay, kegon: "vayhi bachodesh hashshevii ba yishmael ben netanya ben elishama" — beyadua shehu rasha ben rasha.

Amar rav nachman: malachi — ze mardochay, velamma nikra shemo malachi? shehaya mishne lammelech. metivi: baruch ben neriyya useraya ben maaseya, vedaniyyel umordochay bilshan vechaggay, zecharya umalachi — kullan nitnabbeu bishnat shetayim ledaryavesh. teyuveta.

Tanya, amar rabbi yehoshua ben korcha: malachi ze ezra, vachachamim omrim: malachi shemo. amar rav nachman: mistabbera keman deamar malachi ze ezra, dichtiv binviut malachi: "bagda yehuda vetoeva neesta veyisrael uvirushalam ki chillel yehuda kodesh Adonai asher ahev uvaal bat el nechar".
Uman afresh nashim goyot — ezra, dichtiv: "vayyaan shechanya ven yechiel mibbene elam vayyomer leezra anachnu maalnu velohenu vannoshev nashim nochriyyot".
Tanu rabbanan: arba nashim yefefiyyot hayu baolam: sara (vaavigayil, rachav) veester, uleman deamar ester yerakroket hayta — mappek ester umeayyel vashti.

Tanu rabbanan: rachav bishmah zinneta, yael — bekolah, avigayil — bizchiratah, michal bat shaul — biriyyaytah. amar rabbi yitzchak: kol haomer "rachav" "rachav" — miyyad nikre. amar leh rav nachman: ana amena "rachav" "rachav" vela ichpat li! amar leh: ki kaamena beyodah uvemakkirah.
"Umordochay yada et kol asher naasa". may amar? rav amar: gava haman meachashverosh, ushemuel amar: gevar malka illaa mimmalka tattaa.
"Vattitchalchal hammalka". may "vattitchalchal"? amar rav: sheppersa nidda, verabbi yirmeya amar: shehutzercha linkaveha.
"Vattikra ester lahatach", amar rav: hatach ze daniel, velamma nikra shemo hatach — shechatachuhu miggedullato. ushemuel amar: shekkol divre malchut nechtachin al piv.
"Ladaat ma ze veal ma ze". amar rabbi yitzchak, shalcha lo: shemma avru yisrael al chamishsha chumeshe tora, dichtiv bahen: "mizze umizze hem ketuvim".
"Vayyaggidu lemordochay et divre ester", veillu ihu la azal legabbeh. mikkan sheen meshivin al hakkalkala.

"Lech kenos et kol hayyehudim" vegomer ad "asher lo chaddat", amar rabbi abba: shello kaddat haya, shebbechol yom vayom ad achshav — beones, veachshav — beratzon. "vechaasher avadti avadti" — keshem sheavadti mibbet abba, kach ovad mimmecha.
"Vayyaavor mardochay". amar rav: sheheevir yom rishon shel pesach betaanit. ushemuel amar: daavar arkuma demayya.

"Vayhi bayyom hashshelishi vattilbash ester malchut". "bigde malchut" mibbee leh! amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: melammed shellevashatta ruach hakkodesh. ketiv hacha: "vattilbash", uchetiv hatam: "veruach lavsha et amasay".

Veamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: leolam al tehi birkat hedyot kalla beenecha, shehare shene gedole haddor berchum shene hedyotot, venitkayyeyma bahen, veellu hen: david vedaniyyel. david — devarcheh aravna, dichtiv: "vayyomer aravna el hammelech vegomer". daniel — devarcheh daryavesh, dichtiv: "elahach di ant palach leh bitdira hu yeshezvinnach".

Veamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: el tehi killat hedyot kalla beenecha, shehare avimelech killel et sara "hinne hu lach kesut enayim", venitkayyem bezarah: "vayhi ki zaken yitzchak vattichhena enav".

Veamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vedam. middat basar vadam — adam shofet kedera veachar kach noten letochah mayim, aval hakkadosh baruch hu — noten mayim veachar kach shofet hakkedera, lekayyem ma shenneemar: "lekol titto hamon mayim bashshamayim".
Veamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: kol haomer davar beshem omro mevi geulla laolam, shenneemar: "vattomer ester lammelech beshem mordochay".
Veamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: tzaddik avad — ledoro avad. mashal leadam sheavda lo margalit, kol makom shehi — margalit shemah, lo avda ella levalah.

"Vechol ze enennu shove li". amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: beshaa sheraa haman et mordochay yoshev beshaar hammelech, amar: "kol ze eno shove li". kidrav chisda, deamar rav chisda: ze ba bifrozbule veze ba
b: Bifrozbute. amar rav pappa: vekaru leh avda demizdabban betulme.
"Vechol ze enennu shove li" — melammed shekkol genazav shel oto rasha chakukin al libbo, uveshaa sheroe et mordochay yoshev beshaar hammelech, amar: kol ze enennu shove li.

Veamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina: atid hakkadosh baruch hu lihyot atara berosh kol tzaddik vetzaddik, shenneemar: "bayyom hahu yihye Adonai tzevaot laateret tzevi [vegomer]". may "laateret tzevi velitzfirat tifara" — laosin tzivyono velamtzappin tifarto. yachol lakkol — talmud lomar: "lishar ammo", lemi shemmesim atzmo keshirayim.

"Uleruach mishpat" — ze haddan et yitzro. "velayyoshev al hammishpat" — ze haddan din emet laamitto. "veligvura" — ze hammitgabber al yitzro. "meshive milchama" — shennosin venotnin bemilchamtah shel tora. "shara" — [ellu talmide chachamim] shemmashkimin umaarivin bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot.
Amra middat haddin lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, ma nishtannu ellu meellu? amar lah hakkadosh baruch hu: yisrael asku battora, ummot haolam lo asku battora.

Amar leh: "gam elle bayyayin shagu uvashshechar tau paku peliliyya", en "paku" ella gehinnam, shenneemar: "velo tihye zot lecha lefuka", veen "peliliyya" ella dayyaynin, shenneemar: "venatan biflilim".

"Vattaamod bachatzar bet hammelech happenimit". amar rabbi levi: kevan shehiggia levet hatztzelamim, nistalleka hemenna shechina. amra: "eli eli lama azavtani"?! shemma atta dan al shogeg kemezid veal ones keratzon?
O shemma al shekkerativ "kelev", shenneemar: "hatztzila mecherev nafshi miyyad kelev yechidati". chazra ukeraattu "arye", shenneemar: "hoshieni mippi arye".

"Vayhi chirot hammelech et ester hammalka". amar rabbi yochanan: shelosha malache hashsharet nizdammenu lah beotah shaa, echad shehigbiah et tzavvarah, veechad shemmashach chut shel chesed aleha, veechad shemmatach et hashsharvit.

Vechamma? amar rabbi yirmeya: shete ammot haya, veheemido al shetem esre, veamri la al shesh esre, veamri la al esrim vearba. bematnita tana: al shishshim, vechen atta motze beammatah shel bat paro, vechen atta motze beshinne reshaim, dichtiv: "shinne reshaim shibbarta", veamar resh lakish: al tikre "shibbarta" ella "shirybavta". rabba bar ofran amar mishshum rabbi elazar sheshshama merabbo verabbo merabbo: matayim.
"Vayyomer lah hammelech leester hammalka ma bakkashatech ad chatzi hammalchut veteas". chatzi hammalchut velo kol hammalchut, velo davar shechotzetz lammalchut, umay nihu — binyan bet hammikdash.
"Yavo hammelech vehaman el hammishte". tanu rabbanan: ma raata ester shezzimmena et haman? rabbi elazar omer: pachim tamna lo, shenneemar: "yehi shulchanam lifnehem lefach".
Rabbi yehoshua omer: mibbet aviha lamda, shenneemar: "im raev sonaacha haachilehu lechem vegomer". rabbi meir omer: kede shello yittol etza veyimrod.

Rabbi yehuda omer: kede shello yakkiru bah shehi yehudit. rabbi nechemya omer: kede shello yomru yisrael: achot yesh lanu bevet hammelech, veyassichu datan min harachamim. rabbi yose omer: kede sheyyehe matzuy lah bechol et. rabbi shimon ben menasya omer: ulay yargish hammakom veyaase lanu nes.

Rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: asbir lo panim kede sheyyehareg hu vehi. rabban gamliel omer: melech hafachpechan haya. amar rabbi gamliel: adayin tzerichin anu lammodai, detanya, rabbi eliezer hammodai omer: kinneattu bammelech kinneattu bassarim.

Rabba amar: "lifne shever gaon". abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: "bechummam ashit et mishtehem vegomer". ashkecheh rabba bar avu leeliyyahu, amar leh: keman chazya ester vaavada hachi? amar leh: kechullehu tannae uchechullehu amorae.
"Vaysapper lahem haman et kevod oshro verov banav", vechamma rov banav? amar rav, sheloshim: asara metu, vaasara nitlu, vaasara mechazzerin al happetachim.
Verabbanan amri: otan shemmechazzerin al happetachim shivim hayu, dichtiv: "seveim ballechem niskaru", al tikre "seveim" ella "shivim".
Verame bar abba amar: kullan matayim ushemona havo, shenneemar: "verov banav". "verov" begimatriyya matan vearbesar havu! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: "verov" ketiv.
"Ballayla hahu nadda shenat hammelech". amar rabbi tanchum: nadda shenat malko shel olam. verabbanan amri: naddu elyonim, naddu tachtonim. rava amar: shenat hammelech achashverosh mammash.

Nefala leh milleta bedateh, amar: may dekamman dezammenteh ester lehaman? dilma etza ka shakli illaveh dehahu gavra lemikteleh. hadar amar: i hachi, la hava gavra derachem li dahava moda li? hadar amar: dilma ikka inish daavad bi tevuta vela perateh, mishshum hachi mimmani inashe vela megallu li, miyyad: "vayyomer lehavi et sefer hazzichronot divre hayyamim".
"Vayyihyu nikraim" — melammed shennikraim meelehen. "vayyimmatze chatuv" — "ketav" mibbee leh? melammed

a: Sheshshimshay mochek vegavriel kotev. amar rabbi assi, daresh rabbi shela ish kefar temarta: uma ketav shellematta shellizchutan shel yisrael — eno nimchak, ketav shelmala — la kol shekken.
"Lo naasa immo davar". amar rava: lo mippene sheohavin et mordochay, ella mippene shessonim et haman.
"Hechin lo". tana: lo hechin.
"Vaase chen lemardochay". amar leh: mannu mardochay? amar leh: "hayyehudi". amar leh: tuva mardechay ikka bihudae. amar leh: "hayyoshev beshaar hammelech".
Amar leh: saggi leh bechad diskarta, i name bechad nahara. amar leh: ha name hav leh, "al tappel davar mikkol asher dibbarta".

"Vayyikkach haman et hallevush veet hassus". azal ashkecheh deyatvi rabbanan kammeh umachve lehu hilchot kemitza lerabbanan, kevan dechazyeh mardechay deappek lekivleh vesuseya mechad bideh, mirtat. amar lehu lerabbanan: hay rashshia lemiktal nafshay ka ate zilu mikkammeh di la tikkavu begachalto. behahi shata nitattef mardechay vekam leh litzlota, ata haman vitev leh kammayyhu veorech ad desallek mardochay litzloteh.

Amar lehu: bemay askitu? amaru leh: bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, man dimnaddev mincha mayyte mele kumetzeh desuleta umitkappar leh. amar lehu: ata mele kumetze kimcha didchu vedache asra alfe kakkere chaspa didi. amar leh: rasha, eved shekkana nechasim, eved lemi unechasim lemi?
Amar leh: kum levosh hane mane urechov hay suseya, devae lach malka. amar leh: la yachelna ad deayelna leve vane veeshkol lemazyay, delav orach ara leishtammoshe bemane demalka hachi.

Shaddara ester vaasartinhu lechullehu be vane ulechullehu ummane. ayyeyleh ihu leve vane veascheye, vaazal veayyti zuza mibbeteh veka shakel beh mazyeh. bahade deka shakel leh innegid veittenach. amar leh: ammay ka mittenachat? amar leh: gavra dahava chashiv leh lemalka mikkullehu ravrevanohi, hasheta lishavveyeh balnay vesappar? amar leh: rasha, velav sappar shel kefar kartzum hayita? tana: haman, sappar shel kefar kartzum haya esrim ushetayim shana.

Batar deshaklinhu lemazyeh, lavshinhu lemaneh, amar leh: sak urechov. amar leh: la yachelna, dichchisha chelay mime taanita. gechen uselek. ki salek, beat beh. amar leh: la ketiv lechu: "binfol oyivcha al tismach"? amar leh: hane mille beyisrael, aval bedidchu ketiv: "veatta al bamotemo tidroch".

"Vayyikra lefanav kacha yease leish asher hammelech chafetz bikaro". ki hava naket veazel bishvila deve haman, chaziteh beratte dekayyma aiggara, sevara hay dirchiv — avu, vehay dimsagge kammeh — mardochay. shekala atzitza devet hakkisse ushedeteh aresha daavu. dalli eneh vachazat daavu hu, nefala meiggara leara umita.

Vehayeynu dichtiv: "vayyashov mordochay el shaar hammelech", amar rav sheshet: sheshshav lesakko uletaanito. "vehaman nidchaf el beto avel vachafuy rosh", "avel" — al bitto, "vachafuy rosh" — al sheera lo.
"Vaysapper haman lezeresh ishto ulechol ohavav vegomer". kare lehu "ohavav" vekare lehu "chachamav". amar rabbi yochanan: kol haomer devar chachma, afillu beummot haolam, nikra chacham.

"Im mizzera hayyehudim mordochay vegomer". amaru leh: i mishshear shevatim kaate — yachlat leh, vei mishshevet yehuda uvinyamin veefrayim umenashshe — la yachlat leh. yehuda, dichtiv: "yadcha beoref oyvecha", inach, dichtiv behu: "lifne efrayim uvinyamin umenashshe orra et gevuratecha".

"Ki nafol tippol lefanav". daresh rabbi yehuda bar ilay: shete nefilot hallalu, lamma? amru lo: umma zo, meshula leafar umeshula lechochavim. keshehen yordin — yordin ad afar, ucheshehen olin — olin ad lakkochavim.
"Vesarise hammelech higgiu vayyavhilu". melammed sheheviuhu bevehala.
"Ki nimkarnu ani veammi vegomer ki en hatztzar shove benezek hammelech". amra lo: tzar ze, eno shove benezek shel melech. ikkeni ba bevashti vekatla, hasheta ikkeni bedidi u(40)vae lemikteli.

"Vayyomer hammelech achashverosh vayyomer leester hammalka". "vayyomer" "vayyomer" lema li? amar rabbi avahu: battechilla al yede turegman, kevan deamra leh middevet shaul kaatena, miyyad: "vayyomer leester hammalka".
"Vattomer ester ish tzar veoyev haman hara hazze". amar rabbi elazar: melammed shehayta machvo kelappe achashverosh, uva malach vesatar yadah kelappe haman.

"Vehammelech kam bachamato vegomer vehammelech shav migginnat habbitan". makkesh shiva lekima: ma kima bechema, af shiva bechema. daazal veashkach lemalache hashsharet deiddemo leh kegavre, veka akri leilane devusetane, vaamar lehu: may ovadayychu? amaru leh: defakkedinan haman.

Ata leveteh, "vehaman nofel al hammitta", "nofel" — "nafal" mibbee leh! amar rabbi elazar: melammed shebba malach vehippilo aleha, amar: vayy mibbeta, vayy mibbara. "vayyomer hammelech hagam lichbosh et hammalka immi babbayit".

"Vayyomer charvona vegomer". amar rabbi elazar: af charvona rasha — beotah etza haya, kevan sheraa shello nitkayyeyma atzato, miyyad barach. vehayeynu dichtiv: "veyashlech alav velo yachmol miyyado baroach yivrach".
"Vachamat hammelech shachacha". shete shechichot hallalu lamma? achat shel malko shel olam veachat shel achashverosh. veamri la: achat shel ester veachat shel vashti.
"Lechullam natan laish chalifot semalot ulevinyamin natan chamesh chalifot". efshar davar shennitztaer bo oto tzaddik —
b: Yikkashel bo? deamar rava bar machseya amar rav chama bar gureya, amar rav: bishvil mishkal shene selaim melat shehosif yaakov leyosef mishshear echav nitgalgel haddavar veyardu avotenu lemitzrayim. amar rabbi binyamin bar yefet: remez ramaz lo, sheatid ben latzet mimmennu, sheyyetze millifne hammelech bachamishsha levushe malchut, shenneemar: "umordochay yatza bilvush malchut techelet vegomer".

"Vayyippol al tzavvere vinyamin achiv". kamma tzavvarin havo leh levinyamin? amar rabbi elazar: bacha al shene mikdashim sheatidin lihyot bechelko shel binyamin vaatidin lecharev. "uvinyamin bacha al tzavvarav" — bacha al mishkan shilo, sheatid lihyot bechelko shel yosef veatid lecharev.

"Vehinne enechem root veene achi vinyamin". amar rabbi elazar, amar lahem: keshem sheen belibbi al binyamin achi, shello haya bimchirati, kach en belibbi alechem. "ki fi hamedabber alechem". kefi — ken libbi.
"Uleaviv shalach kezot asara chamorim nosim mittuv mitzrayim". may "mittuv mitzrayim"? amar rabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi elazar: shalach lo yayin [yashan], sheddaat zekenim nocha hemennu.
"Vayyelchu gam echav vayyippelu lefanav". amar rabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi elazar, hayeynu deamri inashe: taala beiddaneh seged leh.
Taala? may betziruteh meachooah? ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar: "vayyishtachu yisrael al rosh hammitta", amar rabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi elazar: taala beiddaneh seged leh.

"Vaynachem otam vaydabber al libbam". amar rabbi binyamin bar yefet amar rabbi elazar: melammed sheamar lahem devarim shemmitkabbelin al hallev: uma asara nerot lo yachlu lechabbot ner echad, ner echad heach yachol lechabbot asara nerot?

"Layyehudim hayta ora vesimcha vesason vikar". amar rav yehuda: "ora" — zo tora, vechen hu omer: "ki ner mitzva vetora or". "simcha" — ze yom tov, vechen hu omer: "vesamachta bechaggecha". "sason" — zo mila, vechen hu omer: "sas anochi al imratecha".
"Vikar" — ellu tefillin, vechen hu omer: "verau kol amme haaretz ki shem Adonai nikra alecha veyaru mimmekka", vetanya, rabbi eliezer haggadol omer: ellu tefillin shebbarosh.

"Veet parshandata vegomer aseret bene haman". amar rav adda demin yafo: "aseret bene haman" vaaseret" tzarich lememrinhu binshima achat, may tama — kullehu bahade hadade nefaku nishmetayyhu. amar rabbi yochanan: vav devayzata" tzarich lemimtecha bizkifa kemuredya delivrut. may tama — kullehu bechad zekifa izdekifu.
Amar rabbi chanina bar pappa, daresh rabbi shela ish kefar temarta: kol hashshirot kullan nichtavot ariach al gabbe levena ulevena al gabbe ariach —
Chutz mishshira zo umalche chenaan, sheariach al gabbe ariach ulevena al gabbe levena. may tama — shello tehe tekuma lemappaltan.
"Vayyomer hammelech leester hammalka beshushan habbira hargu hayyehudim". amar rabbi avahu: melammed shebba malach usetaro al piv.
"Uvevoah lifne hammelech amar im hassefer". "amar" — "amra" mibbee leh! amar rabbi yochanan, amra lo: yeamer bappe ma shekkatuv bassefer.
"Divre shalom veemet". amar rabbi tanchum, veamri la amar rabbi assi: melammed shetztzericha sirtut kaamitta shel tora.
"Umaamar ester kiyyaym". "maamar ester" — in, "divre hatztzomot" — la?! amar rabbi yochanan: "divre hatztzomot ... umaamar ester kiyyaym (et yeme) happurim haelle".
"Ki mordochay hayyehudi mishne lammelech achashverosh vegadol layyehudim veratzuy lerov echav". "lerov echav", velo lechol echav. melammed sheppershu mimmennu miktzat sanhedrin.

Amar rav yosef: gadol talmud tora yoter mehatztzalat nefashot, demeikkara chashev leh lemordochay batar arbea, ulevassof batar chamsha. meikkara ketiv: "asher bau im zerubbavel yeshua nechemya seraya reelaya mordochay bilshan", ulevassof ketiv: "habbaim im zerubbavel yeshua nechemya azarya raamya nachamani mordochay bilshan".
Amar rav veittema rav shemuel bar marta: gadol talmud tora yoter mibbinyan bet hammikdash, shekkol zeman shebbaruch ben neriyya kayyaym — lo hinnicho ezra veala.
Amar rabba amar rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta: gadol talmud tora yoter mikkibbud av vaem, shekkol otan shanim shehaya yaakov avinu bevet ever lo neenash, deamar mar:

a: Lamma nimnu shenotav shel yishmael? kede leyaches bahen shenotav shel yaakov. dichtiv: "veelle shene chayye yishmael meat shana usheloshim shana vesheva shanim". kamma kashshish yishmael miyyitzchak? arbesar shenin, dichtiv: "veavram ben shemonim shana veshesh shanim beledet hagar et yishmael leavram", uchetiv: "veavraham ben meat shana behivvaled lo et yitzchak beno", uchetiv: "veyitzchak ben shishshim shana beledet otam", bar kamma hava yishmael kidityelid yaakov? bar shivim vearbea, kamma payyshan mishsheneh — shittin utelat.

Vetanya: haya yaakov avinu beshaa shennitbarech meaviv ben shishshim veshalosh shana, uvo bapperek met yishmael. dichtiv: "vayyar esav ki verach vegomer vayyelech esav el yishmael vayyikkach et machalat bat yishmael achot nevayot", mimmashma shenneemar "bat yishmael", eni yodea shehi achot nevayot? melammed shekkiddeshah yishmael vamet, vehissiah nevayot achiha.
Shittin utelat vearbesar ad demityelid yosef, ha shivin veshiva, uchetiv: "veyosef ben sheloshim shana beomdo lifne paro", ha mea usheva, shav desiva vetarte dechafna — ha mea veshittesar,
Uchetiv: "vayyomer paro el yaakov kamma yeme shene chayyecha. vayyomer yaakov el paro yeme shene meguray sheloshim umeat shana", mea veshittesar havyayn,

Ella shema minna arba esre shenin dahava bevet ever la chashev lehu. detanya: haya yaakov bevet ever muteman arba esre shana. ever met leachar sheyyarad yaakov avinu laaram naharayim shete shanim, yatza mishsham uva lo laaram naharayim, nimtza kesheamad al habbeer — ben shivim vasheva shana.

Umenalan dela ianash — detanya: nimtza yosef shepperash meaviv esrim ushetayim shana, keshem shepperash yaakov avinu meaviv, deyaakov telatin veshitta havyayn! ella: arbesar dahava bevet ever la chashev lehu.

Sof sof devet lavan esrin shenin havyayn! ella mishshum deishtahi beorcha tarten shenin, detanya: yatza mearam naharayim uva lo lesukkot, veasa sham shemona asar chodesh, shenneemar: "veyaakov nasa sukkota vayyiven lo bayit ulemiknehu asa sukkot", uvevet el asa shishsha chodashim, vehikriv zevachim.
Hadaran alach megilla nikret
Hakkore et hammegilla lemafrea — lo yatza. keraah al pe, keraah targum bechol lashon — lo yatza. aval korin otah lalloazot belaaz, vehalloez sheshshama ashshurit — yatza.
Keraah serugin umitnamnem — yatza. haya kotvah, dorshah umaggihah, im kivvevn libbo — yatza, veim lav — lo yatza.
Hayta ketuva besam uvesikra uvekomos uvekankantom, al hanneyayr veal haddiftera — lo yatza, ad shettehe ketuva ashshurit, al hassefer, uvidyo.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rava, deamar kera: "kichtavam vechizmannam" — ma zemannam lemafrea la, af ketavam lemafrea la.

Midde "keria" ketiva hacha? "asiyyay" ketiva, dichtiv: "lihyot osim et shene hayyamim", ella mehacha, dichtiv: "vehayyamim haelle nizkarim venaasim", ittakkash zechira laasiyyay: ma asiyyay lemafrea la, af zechira lemafrea la.
Tana: vechen behallel, vechen bikriat shema uvitfilla.
Hallel menalan? rabba amar, dichtiv: "mimmizrach shemesh ad mevoo". rav yosef amar: "ze hayyom asa Adonai".
Rav avya amar: "yehi shem Adonai mevorach". verav nachman bar yitzchak, veittema rav acha bar yaakov amar: mehacha: "meatta vead olam".
Keriat shema, detanya: keriat shema kichtavah, divre rabbi, vachachamim omrim: bechol lashon. may tama derabbi? amar kera:
b: "Vehayu", bahavayatan yehu. verabbanan, may tama? amar kera: "shema", bechol lashon sheatta shomea.
Verabbi name, ha ketiv: "shema"? hahu mibbee leh: hashema leaznecha ma sheatta motzi mippicha. verabbanan — savri keman deamar hakkore et shema velo hishmia leozno yatza.
Verabbanan name, hachtiv "vehayu"? hahu mibbee leh shello yikra lemafrea. verabbi, shello yikra lemafrea mena leh? middevarim" "haddevarim". verabbanan — "devarim" "haddevarim" la mashma lehu.
Lema kasavar rabbi kol hattora kullah bechol lashon neemra, dei salka datach bilshon hakkodesh neemra — lema li lemichtav "vehayu"!
Itzterich, salka datach "shema" — kerabbanan, ketav rachamana "vehayu".
Lema kasavri rabbanan kol hattora bilshon hakkodesh neemra, dei salka datach bechol lashon neemra — lema li lemichtav "shema"!
Itzterich, salka datach amena "vehayu" — kerabbi, ketav rachamana "shema".

Tefilla mena lan? detanya: shimon happakoli hisdir shemone esre berachot lifne rabban gamliel al hasseder beyavne. amar rabbi yochanan, veamri la bematnita tana: mea veesrim zekenim, uvahem kamma neviim, tikkenu shemone esre berachot al hasseder.

Tanu rabbanan: minnayin sheomrim avot — shenneemar: "havu laAdonai bene elim". uminnayin sheomrim gevurot — shenneemar: "havu laAdonai kavod vaoz". uminnayin sheomrim kedushshot — shenneemar: "havu laAdonai kevod shemo hishtachavu laAdonai behaderat kodesh".

Uma rau lomar bina achar kedushsha — shenneemar: "vehikdishu et kedosh yaakov veet elohe yisrael yaaritzu", usemich leh: "veyadu toe ruach bina". uma rau lomar teshuva achar bina — dichtiv: "ulevavo yavin vashav verafa lo".
I hachi — lema refua batra ditshuva? la salka datach, dichtiv: "veyashov el Adonai virachamehu veel elohenu ki yarbe lisloach".

Umay chazet desamchat aha? semoch aha! ketav kera acharina: "hassoleach lechol avonechi harofe lechol tachaluaychi haggoel mishshachat chayyaychi". lememra digulla urefua batar selicha hi, vehachtiv: "vashav verafa lo"! hahu lav refua detachluim hi, ella refua dislicha hi.

Uma rau lomar geulla bishviit? amar rava: mittoch sheatidin liggael bishviit — lefichach kevauha bishviit. vehaamar mar: beshishshit kolot, bishviit milchamot, bemotzae sheviit ben david ba! milchama name atchalta digulla hi.
Uma rau lomar refua bishminit? amar rabbi acha: mittoch shennittena mila bishminit shetztzericha refua — lefichach kevauha bishminit.
Uma rau lomar birkat hashshanim bitshiit? amar rabbi alekkesanderi: keneged mafkie shearim, dichtiv: "shevor zeroa rasha", vedavid ki amra — bitshiit amra.

Uma rau lomar kibbutz galiyyot leachar birkat hashshanim? dichtiv: "veattem hare yisrael anpechem tittenu uferyechem tisu leammi yisrael ki kervu lavo". vechevan shennitkabbetzu galiyyot — naase din barshaim, shenneemar: "veashiva yadi alayich veetzrof kabbor sigayich", uchetiv: "veashiva shoftayich kevarishona".
Vechevan shennaasa din min harshaim — kalu happoshim, vecholel zedim immahem, shenneemar: "veshever poshim vechattaim yachdav (yichlu)".

Vechevan shekkalu happoshim — mitromemet keren tzaddikim, dichtiv: "vechol karne reshaim agaddea teromamna karnot tzaddik". vecholel gere hatztzedek im hatztzaddikim, shenneemar: "mippene seva takum vehadarta pene zaken" — usemich leh: "vechi yagur ittechem ger".
Vehechan mitromemet karnam — birushalayim, shenneemar: "shaalu shelom yerushalam yishlayu ohavayich".
Vechevan shennivnet yerushalayim — ba david, shenneemar:

a: "Achar yashuvu bene yisrael uvikshu et Adonai elohehem veet david malkam". vechevan shebba david — bata tefilla, shenneemar: "vahaviotim el har kodshi vesimmachtim bevet tefillati".
Vechevan shebbat tefilla — bat avoda, shenneemar: "olotehem vezivchehem leratzon al mizbechi". vechevan shebbat avoda — bata toda, shenneemar: "zoveach toda yechabbedanni".
Uma rau lomar birkat kohanim achar hodaa? dichtiv: "vayyissa aharon et yadav el haam vayvarchem vayyered measot hachattat vehaola vehashshelamim".
Ema, kodem avoda? la salka datach, dichtiv: "vayyered measot hachattat vegomer". mi ketiv "laasot", "measot" ketiv.
Velemra achar haavoda! la salka datach, dichtiv: "zoveach toda".
May chazet desamchat ahay, semoch ahay! mistabbera avoda vehodaa chada milleta hi.
Uma rau lomar "sim shalom" achar birkat kohanim? dichtiv: "vesamu et shemi al bene yisrael vaani avarchem", beracha dehakkadosh baruch hu shalom, shenneemar: "Adonai yevarech et ammo vashshalom".
Vechi meachar demea veesrim zekenim umehem kamma neviim tikkenu tefilla al hasseder, shimon happakoli may hisdir? shechachum, vechazar vesidderom.

Mikkan veelach, asur lesapper beshivcho shel hakkadosh baruch hu. deamar rabbi elazar, may dichtiv: "mi yemallel gevurot Adonai yashmia kol tehillato", lemi nae lemallel gevurot Adonai lemi sheyyachol lehashemia kol tehillato.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: hamesapper beshivcho shel hakkadosh baruch hu yoter midday — neekar min haolam, shenneemar: "hayesuppar lo ki adabber im amar ish ki yevulla".

Daresh rabbi yehuda ish kefar gibborayya, veamri la ish kefar gibbor chayil: may dichtiv: "lecha dumiyya tehilla"? samma decholla — mashtuka. ki ata rav dimi, amar: amri bemareva: milla — besela, mashtuka — bitren.

Keraah al pe lo yatza vechulei. menalan? amar rava: atya zechira zechira, ketiv hacha: "vehayyamim haelle nizkarim", uchetiv hatam: "ketov zot zikkaron bassefer". ma lehallan — besefer, af kan — besefer.
Umimmay dehay zechira keria hi, dilma iyyun bealma! la salka datach (dichtiv): "zachor" — yachol ballev? keshehu omer "lo tishkach", hare shichchat hallev amur, ha ma ani mekayyem "zachor" — bappe.
Keraah targum lo yatza vechulei. hechi dame? illema dichtiva mikra vekare la targum, hayeynu al pe! la tzericha, dichtiva targum vekare la targum.
Aval korin otah lalloazot belaaz vechulei. veha amrat: keraah bechol lashon — lo yatza! rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: belaaz yevoni.
Hechi dame? illema dichtiva ashshurit vekare la yevonit, hayeynu al pe! amar rabbi acha amar rabbi elazar: shekketuva belaaz yevonit.

Veamar rabbi acha amar rabbi elazar: minnayin shekkerao hakkadosh baruch hu leyaakov "el", shenneemar: "vayyikra lo el elohe yisrael". dei salka datach lemizbeach kera leh yaakov "el" — "vayyikra lo yaakov" mibbee leh! ella "vayyikra lo", leyaakov, "el". umi kerao "el" — "elohe yisrael".
Metivi: keraah gippetit, ivrit, elamit, madit, yevonit — lo yatza!
Ha la damya ella leha: gippetit legippetim, ivrit leivrim, elamit leelamim, yevonit livonim — yatza.

I hachi, rav ushemuel ammay mokmi la lematnitin belaaz yevonit? lokmuha bechol laaz! [ella, matnitin kevarayyta.] vechi ittemar derav ushemuel, bealma ittemar. rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu: laaz yevoni lakkol kasher.
Veha katane: yevonit livonim [livonim] — in, lechulle alma — la! inhu daamur kerabban shimon ben gamliel. ditnan, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af sefarim lo hittiru sheyyikkatvu ella yevonit.
Velemru: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel? i amri halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel, hava amena hane mille shear sefarim, aval megilla dichtiv ba "kichtavam" — ema la. ka mashma lan.
Vehalloez sheshshama ashshurit yatza vechulei. veha la yada may kaamri? midde dehave annashim veamme haaretz.
Matkef la ravina: attu anan "haachashteranim bene harammachim", mi yadinan? ella mitzvat keria ufarsome nissa, hacha name — mitzvat keria ufarsome nissa.
Keraah serugin yatza vechulei. la havo yadi rabbanan may "serugin", shamuha leammeta deve rabbi dekaamra lehu lerabbanan dahavo ayyli piske piske leve rabbi: ad matay attem nichnasin serugin serugin?
La havo yadi rabbanan may "chaloglogot". shamuha leammeta deve rabbi daamara leh lehahu gavra dahava ka mevaddar parpechine: ad matay atta mefazzer chaloglogcha?
La havo yadi rabbanan may "salseleha uterommekka". shamuha leammeta deve rabbi dahavot amra lehahu gavra dahava mehappech bemazyeh, amara leh: ad matay atta mesalsel bisarcha?
La havo yadi rabbanan may: "hashelech al Adonai yehavcha". amar rabba bar bar chana: zimna chada hava azelna bahade hahu tayyaya, veka darena tuna vaamar li: shekol yahbaych ushedi aggamlay.
La havo yadi rabbanan may "vetetetiha bematate hashemed". shamuha leammeta deve rabbi dahavot amra lachavertah: shekuli tatita vetati beta.
Tanu rabbanan: keraah serugin — yatza,
b: Serusin — lo yatza. rabbi muna omer mishshum rabbi yehuda: af beserugin, im shaha kede ligmor et kullah — chozer larosh. amar rav yosef: halacha kerabbi muna sheamar mishshum rabbi yehuda.
Amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: kede ligmor et kullah — mehecha dekae lesefa, o dilma: meresha lesefa? amar leh: meresha lesefa, deim ken, natatta devarecha leshiurin.

Amar rabbi abba amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rav: halacha kerabbi muna. ushemuel amar: en halacha kerabbi muna. besura matnu hachi. befumebdita matnu hachi: amar rav kahana amar rav: halacha kerabbi muna. ushemuel amar: en halacha kerabbi muna. rav bivi matni ippecha, rav amar: en halacha kerabbi muna, ushemuel amar: halacha kerabbi muna.

Amar rav yosef: nekot derav bivi bidach, dishmuel hu dechayesh lichidaa. ditnan: shomeret yavam shekkiddesh achiv et achotah, mishshum rabbi yehuda ben betira amru, omrim lo: hameten ad sheyyaase achicha haggadol maase.
Amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yehuda ben betira.
Tanu rabbanan: hishmit bah sofer otiyyot o pesukin ukeraan hakkore kimturegman hametargem — yatza.
Metivi: hayu bah otiyyot metushetashot o mekoraot, im rishshuman nikkar — keshera, veim lav — pesula! la kashya: ha bechulla, ha bemiktzata.

Tanu rabbanan: hishmit bah hakkore pasuk echad, lo yomar: ekra et kullah veachar kach ekra oto pasuk, ella kore meoto pasuk veelach. nichnas levet hakkeneset umatza tzibbur shekkaru chetzyah, lo yomar: ekra chetzyah im hatztzibbur veachar kach ekra chetzyah, ella kore otah mittechillatah vead sofah.
Mitnamnem yatza vechulei. hechi dame mitnamnem? amar rav ashe: nim vela nim, tir vela tir, dekaru leh veane vela yada leahdore sevara, vechi madkeru leh middechar.
Haya kotvah dorshah umaggihah im kivvevn libbo yatza vechulei. hechi dame? i deka mesaddar pesuka pesuka vechatev la, ki kivvevn libbo may have? al pe hu! ella dechatev pesuka pesuka vekare leh,
Umi yatza? vehaamar rabbi chelbo amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: halacha kedivre haomer kullah. vaafillu leman deamar "meish yehudi" — tzericha shettehe ketuva kullah!

Ella: demannecha megilla kammeh vekare (la) minna pesuka pesuka vechatav lah. lema mesayyay leh lerabba bar bar chana, deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: asur lichtov ot achat shello min hakketav. dilma deitremi leh itremoye.

Gufa, amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: asur lichtov ot achat shello min hakketav. metivi, amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: maase berabbi meir shehalach leabber shana beasya, velo haya sham megilla uchetavah millibbo — ukeraah!

Amar rabbi avahu: shane rabbi meir demikkayyaym beh "veafappecha yayshiru negdecha". amar leh rame bar chama lerabbi yirmeya middifti: may "veafappecha yayshiru negdecha"? amar lo: ellu divre tora, dichtiv behu: "hataif enecha bo veenennu", vaafillu hachi meyushsharin hen etzel rabbi meir.

Rav chisda ashkecheh lerav chananel dahava katev sefarim shello min hakketav, amar leh: reuya kol hattora kullah likkatev al pich, ella kach amru chachamim: asur lichtov ot achat shello min hakketav. middekaamar: kol hattora kullah reuya shettikkatev al pich, mikkelal dimyushsharin hen etzlo, veha rabbi meir katav? sheat haddechak shane.

Abbaye shera lidve bar chavu lemichtav tefillin umezuzot shello min hakketav. keman? ki hay tanna, detanya: rabbi yirmeya omer mishshum rabbenu: tefillin umezuzot nichtavot shello min hakketav, veen tzerichot sirtut.
Vehilcheta: tefillin en tzerichin sirtut, mezuzot tzerichin sirtut. idde veidde nichtavot shello min hakketav. may tama — migras gerisin.
Hayta ketuva besam kulei. sam — samma. sikra, amar rabba bar bar chana: sekarta shema. komos — koma.

a: Kankantom — charta deushekafe. diftera — dimliach ukemiach vela afitz. neyayr — mechaka.
Ad shettehe ketuva ashshurit, dichtiv: "kichtavam vechizmannam".

"Al hassefer uvidyo vechulei". menalan? atya "ketiva" "ketiva". ketiv hacha: "vattichtov ester hammalka", uchetiv hatam: "vayyomer lahem baruch mippiv yikra elay et kol haddevarim haelle vaani kotev al hassefer baddeyo".
Mishna ben ir shehalach lichrach uven kerach shehalach leir, im atid lachzor limkomo — kore kimkomo, veim lav — kore immahen.
Umehechan kore adam et hammegilla veyotze bah yede chova? rabbi meir omer: kullah. rabbi yehuda omer: meish yehudi". rabbi yose omer: meachar haddevarim haelle".

Gemara amar rava: lo shanu ella sheatid lachzor belele arbaa asar, aval en atid lachzor belele arbaa asar — kore immahen. amar rava: mena amena la? dichtiv: "al ken hayyehudim happerazim hayyoshvim beare happerazot". mikkede ketiv: "hayyehudim happerazim", lema li lemichtav "hayyoshvim beare happerazot"? ha ka mashma lan, defaruz ben yomo nikra paruz.
Ashkechan paruz, mukkaf mena lan? sevara hu: middefaruz ben yomo karuy paruz, mukkaf ben yomo karuy mukkaf.

Veamar rava: ben kefar shehalach leir — ben kach uven kach kore immahen. may tama? hay kivne hair bae lemikre, verabbanan hu daakillu al hakkefarim kede sheyyesappeku mayim umazon laachehem shebbakkerakkin. hane mille — ki iteh beducheteh, aval ki iteh beir — kivne ir bae lemikre.
Etiveh abbaye: ben kerach shehalach leir — ben kach uven kach kore kimkomo. ben kerach salka datach?! beim atid lachzor talya milleta, ella lav, ben kefar.
Velav tarotze metartzat? teni: kore immahen.
Mehechan kore adam et hammegilla vechulei. tanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: mibballayla hahu".
Amar rabbi yochanan, vechullan mikra echad darshu: "vattichtov ester hammalka umordochay hayyehudi et kol tokef", man deamar kullah — tokpo shel achashverosh.
Uman deamar meish yehudi" — tokpo shel mardochay, uman deamar meachar haddevarim haelle" — tokpo shel haman, uman deamar mibballayla hahu" — tokpo shel nes.
Rav huna amar, mehacha: "uma rau al kacha uma higgia alehem",
Man deamar kullah: "ma raa" — achashverosh shennishtammesh bechelim shel bet hammikdash, "al kacha" — mishshum dechashshev shivim shenin vela ipperuk, "uma higgia alehem" — diktal vashti.
Uman deamar meish yehudi": "ma raa" — mardechay deikkanni behaman, "al kacha" — deshavvi nafsheh avoda zara, "uma higgia alehem" — deitrechish nissa.

Uman deamar meachar haddevarim haelle": "ma raa" — haman shennitkanne bechol hayyehudim, "al kacha" — mishshum demardechay "lo yichra velo yishtachave", "uma higgia alehem" — "vetalu oto veet banav al haetz".
Uman deamar mibballayla hahu": "ma raa" — achashverosh lehavi et sefer hazzichronot, "al kacha" — dezammenteh ester lehaman bahadeh, "uma higgia alehem" — deitrechish nissa.
Amar rabbi chelbo amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: halacha kedivre haomer kullah. vaafillu leman deamar meish yehudi" — tzericha shettehe ketuva kullah.

Veamar rabbi chelbo amar rav chama bar gureya amar rav: megilla nikret "sefer", venikret "iggeret". nikret "sefer" — sheim tefarah bechute fishtan pesula. venikret "iggeret" — sheim hetil bah shelosha chute gidin keshera. amar rav nachman: uvilvad sheyyehu meshullashin.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: hakkore bimgilla hakketuva ben hakketuvim — lo yatza. amar rava: la amaran ella dela mechassera umeyaytra pureta, aval mechassera umeyaytra pureta — let lan ba.
Levi bar shemuel hava ka kare kammeh derav yehuda bimgilla
b: Hakketuva ben hakketuvim. amar leh: hare amru, hakkore bimgilla hakketuva ben hakketuvim — lo yatza.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: hakkore bimgilla hakketuva ben hakketuvim — lo yatza. umachu la ammocha: betzibbur shanu.
Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: shiyyur hattefer — halacha lemoshe missinay. umachu la ammocha: velo amru ella kede shello yikkara.

Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: ilmale nishtayyer bimara sheamad bah moshe veeliyyahu kimlo nekev machat sidkit, lo hayu yecholin laamod mippene haora, shenneemar: "ki lo yirani haadam vachay".

Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv: "vaalehem kechol haddevarim asher dibber Adonai immachem bahar" — melammed sheherahu hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe dikduke tora vedikidduke sofrim uma shehassofrim atidin lechaddesh, umay nihu? mikra megilla.
Mishna hakkol kesherin likrot et hammegilla, chutz mecheresh shote vekatan. rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan.
Gemara man tena cheresh diavad name la? amar rav matna: rabbi yose hi, ditnan: hakkore et shema velo hishmia leozno — yatza, rabbi yose omer: lo yatza.
Umimmay derabbi yose hi vediavad name la? dilma rabbi yehuda hi, ulechattechilla hu dela, ha diavad — shappir dame?
La salka datach, dekatane cheresh dumeya deshote vekatan: ma shote vekatan — diavad name la, af cheresh — diavad name la.
Vedilma ha kidita veha kidita! middekatane sefa: rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan — mikkelal deresha lav rabbi yehuda hi.
Vedilma kulla rabbi yehuda hi! mi dame? resha lifsula, vesefa lichshera.

Vedilma kulla rabbi yehuda hi, utere gavvne katan katane la, vechassore michassera vehachi katane: hakkol kesherin likrot et hammegilla chutz mecheresh shote vekatan, bamme devarim amurim — bekatan shello higgia lechinnuch, aval bekatan shehiggia lechinnuch — afillu lechattechilla. sherabbi yehuda machshir bekatan.
Bemay okemta — kerabbi yehuda, vediavad?
Ella ha detane (rabbi) yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi: cheresh hamedabber veeno shomea torem lechattechilla, manni? i rabbi yehuda — diavad in lechattechilla la, i rabbi yose — diavad name la.

Veella may — rabbi yehuda vaafillu lechattechilla? ella ha detanya: lo yevarech adam birkat hammazon belibbo, veim berach yatza, manni? la rabbi yehuda vela rabbi yose! i rabbi yehuda — afillu lechattechilla, i rabbi yose — afillu diavad name la!

a: Leolam rabbi yehuda, vaafillu lechattechilla. vela kashya: ha dideh, ha derabbeh.

Detanya, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi elazar ben azarya: hakkore et shema tzarich sheyyashmia leozno, shenneemar: "shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad" — hashema leaznecha ma sheatta motzi mippicha. rabbi meir omer: "asher anochi metzavvecha hayyom al levavecha" — achar kauonat hallev hen hen haddevarim.
Hasheta deatet lehachi — afillu tema rabbi yehuda kerabbeh sevira leh, veha detane yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi — rabbi meir hi.
Rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan. (detanya) amar rabbi yehuda: katan hayiti, ukeritiha lemala merabbi tarfon uzekenim belod. amru lo: en meviin reaya min hakkatan.
Tanya, amar rabbi: katan hayiti, ukeritiha lemala merabbi yehuda, amru lo: en meviin reaya min hammattir.
Velemru leh: en meviin reaya min hakkatan! chada veod kaamru leh. chada: dekatan hayita, veod: afillu gadol hayita — en meviin reaya min hammattir.
Mishna en korin et hammegilla, velo malin, velo tovlin, velo mazzin, vechen shomeret yom keneged yom — lo titbol ad shettanetz hachamma. vechullan sheasu mishsheala ammud hashshachar — kasher.

Gemara menalan? deamar kera: "vehayyamim haelle nizkarim venaasim" — bayyom in, ballayla la. lema tehve teyuveta derabbi yehoshua ben levi, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: chayyayv adam likrot et hammegilla ballayla velishnotah bayyom! ki katane — addeyom.
Velo malin vechulei. dichtiv: "uvayyom hashshemini yimmol".
Velo tovlin velo mazzin vechulei. dichtiv: "vehizza hattahor al hattame [vegomer] bayyom hashshevii", veittakkash tevila lehazzaya.
Vechen shomeret yom keneged yom lo titbol ad shettanetz hachamma vechulei. peshita! may shena shomeret yom keneged yom mikkol chayyayve tevilot!

Itzterich: salka datach amena tehve kiriyya rishona shel zav — ureiyya rishona shel zav ittakkash levaal keri, dichtiv: "zot torat hazzav vaasher tetze mimmennu shichvat zara". ma baal keri tovel bayyom — hay name litbol beyomeh.
Veha bimama la matzya tavla, dichtiv: "kol yeme zovah kemishkav niddatah yihye lah", belelya mihat lebed miktzat shimmur, vetitbol, ka mashma lan kevan devaaya sefira —
b: Sefira bimama hi.
Vechullan sheasu mishsheala ammud hashshachar kasher. menahane mille? amar rava: deamar kera: "vayyikra elohim laor yom", lammeir uva kerao "yom".
Ella meatta: "velachoshech kara layla" [lammachshich uva kara layla]? ha kayyma lan dead tzet hakkochavim lav layla hu!
Ella amar rabbi zera, mehacha: "vaanachnu osim bammelacha vechetzyam machazikim barmachim mealot hashshachar ad tzet hakkochavim", veomer: "(vehaya) lanu hallayla (lemishmar)".
May veomer? vechi tema: mishsheala ammud hashshachar lav yemama, umikki arva shimsha lelya, veinhu mekaddemi umechashshechi — ta shema: "(vehaya) lanu hallayla mishmar vehayyom melacha".
Mishna kol hayyom kasher likriat hammegilla, velikriat hahallel, velitkiat shofar, velintilat lulav, velitfillat hammusafin, ulemusafin,
Ulevidduy happarim, ulevidduy maaser, ulevidduy yom hakkippurim.
Lismicha, lishchita, litnufa, lehaggasha, likmitza, ulehaktara, limlika, ulekabbala, ulehazzaya,
Ulehashkayayt sota, velaarifat haegla, uletohorat hammetzora.
Kol hallayla kasher liktzirat haomer, ulehekter chalavim, veevarim. ze hakkelal: davar shemmitzvato bayyom — kasher kol hayyom. davar shemmitzvato ballayla — kasher kol hallayla.
Gemara menalan? deamar kera: "vehayyamim haelle nizkarim venaasim". likriat hahallel, dichtiv: "mimmizrach shemesh ad mevoo". (rabbi yose) omer: "ze hayyom asa Adonai".

Velintilat lulav, dichtiv: "ulekachtem lachem bayyom harishon". velitkiat shofar, dichtiv: "yom terua yihye lachem". ulemusafin, dichtiv: "devar yom beyomo". velitfillat hammusafin — kemusafin shavveyuha rabbanan.

Ulevidduy parim, deyalef "kappara" "kappara" miyyom hakkippurim. detanya gabbe yom hakkippurim: "vechipper baado uvead beto" — bechapparat devarim hakkatuv medabber. vechappara bimama hu, dichtiv: "bayyom hazze yechapper alechem".
Ulevidduy maaser vechulei, dichtiv: "veamarta lifne Adonai elohecha biarti hakkodesh min habbayit", usemich leh: "hayyom hazze Adonai elohecha metzavvecha".
Lismicha velishchita, dichtiv: "vesamach ... veshachat", uchetiv ba bishchita: "bayyom zivchachem". velitnufa, dichtiv: "beyom hanifchem et haomer".

Ulehaggasha — deittakkash litnufa, dichtiv: "velakach hakkohen miyyad haishsha et minchat hakkenaot vehenif... vehikriv". velimlika velikmitza ulehaktara ulehazzaya, dichtiv: "bayyom tzauoto et bene yisrael".
Ulehashkayayt sota — atya "tora" "tora". ketiv hacha: "veasa lah hakkohen et kol hattora hazzot", uchetiv hatam: "al pi hattora asher yorucha veal hammishpat".

a: Ma mishpat bayyom — af kan bayyom.
Velaarifat haegla, amri deve rabbi yannay: kappara ketiv bah, kekadashim. uletohorat metzora, dichtiv: "zot tihye torat hammetzora beyom tohorato".
Kol hallayla kasher liktzirat haomer vechulei, deamar mar: ketzira usefira — ballayla, vahavaa — bayyom. ulehekter chalavim veevarim, dichtiv: "kol hallayla ad habboker".
Ze hakkelal: davar shemmitzvato beyom — kasher kol hayyom. ze hakkelal leetoye may? leetoye siddur bazichin vesilluk bazichin,
Ucherabbi yose. detanya, rabbi yose omer: sillek et hayyeshana shacharit, vesidder et hachadasha arvit — en bechach kelum.
Uma ani mekayyem ("lifne Adonai tamid") — shello yehe shulechan belo lechem.
Davar shemmitzvato ballayla — kasher kol hallayla. leetoye may?

Leetoye achilat pesachim, udela kerabbi elazar ben azarya. detanya: "veachlu et habbasar ballayla hazze", amar rabbi elazar ben azarya: neemar kan "ballayla hazze" veneemar lehallan "veavarti veeretz mitzrayim ballayla hazze", ma lehallan ad chatzot, af kan ad chatzot.
Hadaran alach hakkore lemafrea
Hakkore et hammegilla — omed veyoshev. keraah echad, kerauha shenayim — yatzu. makom shennahagu levarech — yevarech, veshello levarech — lo yevarech.
Besheni, vachamishi, bashshabbat bammincha — korin shelosha. en pochatin mehen, veen mosifin alehen, veen maftirin bannavi. happoteach vehachotem battora — mevarech lefaneha uleachareha.
Berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed — korin arbaa. en pochatin mehen, veen mosifin alehen, veen maftirin bannavi. happoteach vehachotem battora — mevarech lefaneha uleachareha.

Ze hakkelal: kol sheyyesh bo musaf veeno yom tov — korin arbaa, beyom tov — chamishsha, beyom hakkippurim — shishsha, beshabbat — shiva. en pochatin mehen, aval mosifin alehen, umaftirin bannavi. happoteach vehachotem battora — mevarech lefaneha uleachareha.

Gemara tana: ma sheen ken battora. menahane mille? amar rabbi avahu, deamar kera: "veatta po amod immadi", veamar rabbi avahu: ilmale mikra katuv, i efshar leomro. kivyachol af hakkadosh baruch hu baamida.
Veamar rabbi avahu: minnayin larav shello yeshev al gabbe mitta veyishne letalmido al gabbe karka, shenneemar: "veatta po amod immadi".

Tanu rabbanan: mimot moshe vead rabban gamliel lo hayu lemedin tora ella meummad. mishshemmet rabban gamliel, yarad choli laolam vehayu lemedin tora meyushshav. vehayeynu ditnan: mishshemmet rabban gamliel batal kevod tora.

Katuv echad omer: "vaeshev bahar", vechatuv echad omer: "veanochi amadti bahar"! amar rav: omed velomed, yoshev veshone. rabbi chanina amar: lo omed velo yoshev ella shoche. rabbi yochanan amar: en "yeshiva" ella leshon akkava, shenneemar: "vatteshvu vekadesh yamim rabbim". rava amar: rakkot meummad, vekashot meyushshav.
Keraah echad, kerauha shenayim yatzu vechulei.
b: Tana: ma sheen ken battora. tanu rabbanan: battora — echad kore veechad metargem, uvilvad shello yehe echad kore ushenayim metargemin. uvannavi — echad kore ushenayim metargemin, uvilvad shello yehu shenayim korin ushenayim metargemin. uvahallel uvammegilla — afillu asara korin vaasara metargemin.
May tama? kevan dachaviva — yahavi datayyhu veshami.
Makom shennahagu levarech — yevarech. amar abbaye: lo shanu ella leachareha, aval lefaneha — mitzva levarech. deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kol hammitzvot kullan mevarech alehen over laasiyyaytan.

May mashma dehay "over" lishshana deakdome hu? amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, amar kera: "vayyarotz achimaatz derech hakkikkar vayyaavor et hakkushi". abbaye amar mehacha: "vehu avar lifnehem". veibbaet ema, mehacha: "vayyaavor malkam lifnehem vaAdonai berosham".
Lefaneha may mevarech? rav sheshet mikkatrazya ikkela lekammeh derav ashe uvarech man"8.

Leachareha may mevarech? baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam (hael) harav et rivenu vehaddan et dinenu vehannokem et nikmatenu vehannifra lanu mitztzarenu vehameshallem gemul lechol oyve nafshenu, baruch atta Adonai hannifra leyisrael mikkol tzarehem. rava amar: hael hammoshia. amar rav pappa: hilkach — nemrinhu letarvayyhu: baruch atta Adonai hannifra leyisrael mikkol tzarehem hael hammoshia.
Besheni uvachamishi bashshabbat bammincha korin shelosha vechulei. hane shelosha, keneged mi? amar rav assi: keneged tora neviim uchetuvim. rava amar: keneged kohanim leviyyim veyisreelim.
Ella ha detane rav shimi: en pochatin measara pesukin bevet hakkeneset, "vaydabber" ole min hamminyan. hane asara keneged mi?

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: keneged asara batlanin shebbevet hakkeneset. rav yosef: amar keneged aseret haddibberot shenneemru lemoshe besinay. (rabbi levi amar: keneged asara hillulin sheamar david besefer tehillim.) verabbi yochanan amar: keneged asara maamarot shebbahen nivra haolam.
He ninhu? "vayyomer" divreshit. hane tisha havu! "bereshit" name maamar hu, dichtiv: "bidvar Adonai shamayim naasu uveruach piv kol tzevaam".
Amar rava, rishon shekkara arbaa — meshubbach, sheni shekkara arbaa — meshubbach, shelishi shekkara arbaa — meshubbach.

Rishon shekkara arbaa meshubbach — ditnan: beshalosh kuppot shel shalosh sein shebbahen tormin et hallishka, vehaya katuv alehen av"3, leda ezo mehen nitrema rishon, lehakeriv mimmenna rishon — shemmitzva barishon.

Emtzai shekkara arbaa meshubbach — detanya: "el mul pene hammenora yairu", melammed shemmetzadded penehem kelappe ner maaravi, vener maaravi kelappe shechina. veamar rabbi yochanan: mikkan sheemtzai meshubbach.
Veacharon shekkara arbaa meshubbach — mishshum maalin bakkodesh velo moridin. rav pappa ikkela leve kenishta daavi govar vekara rishon arbaa, veshabbecheh rav pappa.
En pochatin mehen veen mosifin. tana: happoteach — mevarech lefaneha, vehachotem — mevarech leachareha.
Vehaiddana, dechullehu mevarchi lefaneha uleachareha — hayeynu tama detakkinu rabbanan: gezera mishshum hannichnasin umishshum hayyotzin.

Berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed korin arbaa vechulei. bea minneh ulla bar rav merava: parashat rosh chodesh, ketzad korin otah? "tzav et bene yisrael veamarta alehem et korbani lachmi", dehavyayn temanya pesuke, hechi nebed?

Nikre tere telata telata pesukin — pashu lehu tere, veen meshayyeyrin bapparasha pachot mishshelosha pesukin. nikre arbaa arbea — pashu lehu shiva, "uveyom hashshabbat" havayin tere, "uverashe chodshechem" havayin chamishsha, hechi naaved? nikre tere meha vechad mehanach —

a: En matchilin bapparasha pachot mishshelosha pesukim. likre tere meha utelata mehach, pashu lehu tere!
Amar lo: zo lo shamati, kayyotze bah shamati, ditnan: bayyom harishon — "bereshit" viyhi rakia", vetane ala: "bereshit" — bishnayim, "yehi rakia" — beechad.
Vehavenan ba: bishlama "yehi rakia" beechad, ditlata pesuke havu, ella "bereshit" bishnayim? chamsha pesuke havu, vetanya: hakkore battora lo yifchot mishshelosha pesukim!
Veittemar ala, rav amar: doleg. ushemuel amar: posek.
Rav amar doleg, may tama la amar posek? kasavar: kol pesuka dela paskeh moshe — anan la paskinan leh.
Ushemuel amar paskinan leh? veha amar rabbi chananya kara: tzaar gadol haya li etzel rabbi chanina haggadol, velo hittir li lifsok ella letinokot shel bet rabban, hoil ulehitlammed asuyin.
Hatam tama may — mishshum dela efshar, hacha name la efshar.
Ushemuel amar posek, may tama la amar doleg? gezera mishshum hannichnasin umishshum hayyotzin.

Metivi: parasha shel shishsha pesukim korin otah bishnayim, veshel chamishsha pesukim beyachid. kara rishon shelosha — hashsheni kore shenayim mipparasha zo veechad mipparasha acheret. veyesh omrim shelosha, lefi sheen matchilin bapparasha pachot mishshelosha pesukim.
Veim ita, leman deamar doleg — nidlog, uleman deamar posek — nifsok!
Shane hatam, deefshar behachi.

Amar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: halacha keyesh omrim, veamar rabbi tanchum amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: keshem sheen matchilin bapparasha pachot mishshelosha pesukim, kach en meshayyeyrin bapparasha pachot mishshelosha pesukim.
Peshita! hasheta uma atchalta, deka makkel tanna kamma — machmeyri yesh omrim, shiyyur, demachmir tanna kamma — lo kol shekken demachmeyri yesh omrim?!
Mahu detema: nichnasin shechichi, yotzin la shechichi, demannechi sefer tora venafki, ka mashma lan.
Vetanna kamma may shena shayyore dela — mishshum yotzin, atchole name, gezera mishshum hannichnasin? amri: man deayel shayyole [m]shayyel.
Shelach leh rabba bereh derava lerav yosef: hilcheta may? shelach leh, hilcheta: doleg, veemtzai dolgan.

Ze hakkelal, kol sheyyesh bo musaf vechulei. ibbaya lehu: taanit tzibbur bechamma? rosh chodesh umoed deikka korban musaf — arbaa, aval hacha delekka korban musaf — la. o dilma: hacha name ikka musaf tefilla.

Ta shema: berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed korin arbaa, ha betaanit tzibbur shelosha! ema resha: besheni uvachamishi uvashshabbat bammincha korin shelosha: ha taanit tzibbur arbaa! ella meha lekka lemishma minna.
Ta shema: derav ikkela levavel betaanit tzibbur, kam kera besifra. petach barech, chataym vela barech. neful kulle alma aanpayyhu, verav la nefal al appeh.
Mikkede rav beyisrael kera, may tama chatam vela barech? lav mishshum devae lemikre acharina batreh?
La, rav bechahane kera. deha rav huna kare bechahane.
Bishlama rav huna kare bechahane, deha afillu rav amme verav assi dechahane chashivi deara yisrael, mikkaf kayyfi leh lerav huna. ella rav — ha ikka shemuel, dechahana hava, vedavar aleh!
Shemuel name mikkaf hava kayif leh lerav, verav hu daavad leh kavod, vechi aved leh — befanav, shello befanav — la aved leh.
Hachi name mistabbera derav bechahane kera, dei salka datach beyisrael kera, lefaneha may tama barech! leachar takkana.
I hachi, leachareha name levarech! shane hecha deyatev rav — demeal ayyli,
b: Mippak la nafki.
Ta shema, ze hakkelal: kol sheyyesh bo bittul melacha laam, kegon taanit tzibbur vetisha beav — korin shelosha,
Vesheen bo bittul melacha laam, kegon rashe chodashim vechullo shel moed — korin arbaa. shema minna.
Amar rav ashe, veha anan la tenan hachi: ze hakkelal, kol yom sheyyesh bo musaf veeno yom tov — korin arbaa. leetoye may? lav leetoye taanit tzibbur vetisha beav!

Ulerav ashe matnitin manni? la tanna kamma vela rabbi yose, detanya: chal lihyot besheni uvachamishi — korin shelosha umaftir echad. bishlishi uvirvii — kore echad umaftir echad. rabbi yose omer: leolam korin shelosha umaftir echad!
Veella, kashya "ze hakkelal"! la, leetoye rosh chodesh umoed.
Ha behedya katane la: berashe chodashim umoed korin arbaa!
Simana bealma yahev, dela tema yom tov vechullo shel moed ki hadade ninhu, ella nekot hay kelala bidach: kol detafe leh milleta mechavreh, tafe leh gavra yattira.
Hilkach berosh chodesh umoed, deikka korban musaf — korin arbaa. beyom tov, deasur baasiyyayt melacha — chamishsha. beyom hakkippurim, deanush karet — shishsha. shabbat, deikka issur sekila — shiva.
Gufa: rav ikkela levavel betaanit tzibbur, kam kera besifra. petach barech, chatam vela barech. neful kulle alma aanpayyhu verav la nefal al anpeh. may tama rav la nefal al appeh?

Ritzpa shel avanim hayta, vetanya: "veeven maskit lo tittenu beartzechem lehishtachavot aleha". "aleha" i atta mishtachave beartzechem, aval atta mishtachave al avanim shel bet hammikdash. kidulla, deamar ulla: lo asra tora ella ritzpa shel avanim bilvad.
I hachi may irya rav, afillu kullehu name! kammeh derav havay.

Velezil legabbe tzibbura velinpol al appeh! la bae (30)maytrach tzibbura. veibbaet ema: rav pishshut yadayim veraglayim hava aved, vechidulla. deamar ulla: la asra tora ella pishshut yadayim veraglayim bilvad.
Velippol al appeh, vela lebed pishshut yadayim veraglayim! la meshanne mimminhageh.

Veibbaet ema: adam chashuv shane, kidrabbi elazar. deamar rabbi elazar: en adam chashuv rashshay lippol al panav ella im ken naane kihoshua bin nun, dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai el yehoshua kum lach [vegomer]".

Tanu rabbanan: kidda — al appayim, shenneemar: "vattikkod bat sheva appayim eretz". keria — al birkayim, vechen hu omer: "mikkeroa al birkav". hishtachavaa — zo pishshut yadayim veraglayim, shenneemar: "havo navo ani veimmecha veachecha lehishtachavot lecha artza".
Levi achvi kidda kammeh derabbi, veittela.
Veha (ka) gerama leh? vehaamar rabbi elazar: leolam al yatiach adam devarim kelappe mala, shehare adam gadol hetiach devarim kelappe mala veittela umannu — levi. ha veha gerama leh.
Amar rav chiyyay bar avin: chazena lehu leabbaye

a: Verava dimtzalle atzloye.

Beyom tov chamishsha, beyom hakkippurim shishsha kulei. matnitin manni? lo rabbi yishmael vela rabbi akiva. detanya: beyom tov chamishsha, uveyom hakkippurim shishsha, uveshabbat shiva, en pochatin mehen veen mosifin alehen, divre rabbi yishmael. rabbi akiva omer: beyom tov chamishsha, uveyom hakkippurim shiva, uveshabbat shishsha, en pochatin mehen aval mosifin alehen.
Manni? i rabbi yishmael — kashya tosefet! i rabbi akiva — kashya shishsha veshiva!
Amar rava: tena deve rabbi yishmael hi. detana deve rabbi yishmael: beyom tov chamishsha, beyom hakkippurim shishsha, beshabbat shiva, en pochatin mehen aval mosifin alehen, divre rabbi yishmael.
Kashya derabbi yishmael adderabbi yishmael! tere tannae allibba derabbi yishmael.

Man tena leha detanya: beyom tov meacharin lavo, umimmuhrin latzet. beyom hakkippurim mimmuhrin lavo, umeacharin latzet. uveshabbat mimmuhrin lavo, umimmuhrin latzet. lema rabbi akiva, deit leh gavra yattira? afillu tema rabbi yishmael — dinfish siddura deyoma.

Hane shelosha chamishsha veshiva keneged mi? peligi ba rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani vechad deamya, umannu — rabbi shimon ben pazzi. veamri la: rabbi shimon ben pazzi vechad deammeh, umannu — rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani, veamri la rabbi shemuel bar nachmani. chad amar: keneged birkat kohanim, vechad amar: keneged shelosha shomre hassaf, chamishsha meroe pene hammelech, shiva roay pene hammelech.

Tane rav yosef: shelosha chamishsha veshiva — shelosha shomre hassaf, chamishsha meroe pene hammelech, shiva roi pene hammelech. amar leh abbaye: ad haiddana may tama la parish lan mar? amar leh: la hava yadana ditzrichitu leh, umi beetu minnay milleta vela amari lechu?!

Amar leh yaakov minaa lerav yehuda: hane shishsha deyom hakkippurim keneged mi? amar leh: keneged shishsha sheamdu mimino shel ezra veshishsha missemolo, shenneemar: "vayyaamod ezra hassofer al migdal etz asher asu laddavar vayyaamod etzlo mattitya veshema vaanaya veuriyya vechilkiyya umaaseya al yemino umissemolo pedaya umishael umalkiyya vechashum vechashbaddana zecharya meshullam".
Hane shiva havu! hayeynu "zecharya" hayeynu "meshullam", veammay kerao "meshullam"? demishlam beovadeh.
Tanu rabbanan: hakkol olin lamminyan shiva, vaafillu katan vaafillu ishsha. aval amru chachamim: ishsha lo tikra betora, mippene kevod tzibbur.
Ibbaya lehu: maftir, mahu sheyyaale lamminyan shiva? rav huna verabbi yirmeya bar abba, chad amar: ole, vechad amar: eno ole. man deamar ola — deha kare,
Uman deamar eno ole — kidulla. deamar ulla: mippene ma hammaftir benavi tzarich shikra betora techilla — mippene kevod tora, vechevan demishshum kevod tora hu — leminyana la salek.
Metivi: hammaftir benavi lo yifchot meesrim veechad pesukin, keneged shiva shekkerao betora. veim ita, esrim vearbaa havyin! kevan demishshum kevod tora hu —
b: Kenegdo name la bae.
Matkef la rava: vahare "olotechem sefo", dela havyin esrin vechad, vekarenan! shane hatam, dislek inyayna.

Vehecha dela salek inyayna la? vehaamar rav shemuel bar abba: zimnin saggiin hava kaemna kammeh derabbi yochanan, vechi hava karenan asara pesuke, amar lan: appesiko! makom sheyyesh turegman shane. detane rav tachlifa bar shemuel: lo shanu ella bimkom sheen turegman, aval makom sheyyesh turegman — posek.
Mishna en porsin al shema, veen ovrin lifne hatteva, veen nosin et kappehem, veen korin betora, veen maftirin bannavi,
Veen osin maamad umoshav, veen omrim birkat avelim vetanchume avelim, uvirkat chatanim, veen mezammenin beshem — pachot measara. uvekarkaot — tisha vechohen, veadam kayyotze bahen.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan, deamar kera: "venikdashti betoch bene yisrael", kol davar shebbikdushsha lo yehe pachot measara.
May mashma? detane rabbi chiyyay: atya "toch" "toch", ketiv hacha: "venikdashti betoch bene yisrael", uchetiv hatam: "hibbadlu mittoch haeda",
Veatya "eda" "eda", dichtiv hatam: "ad matay laeda haraa hazzot" — ma lehallan asara, af kan asara.
Veen osin maamad umoshav pachot measara. kevan devae lememar: "imdu yekarim amodu, shevu yekarim shevu" — betzir measara lav orach ara.

Veen omrim birkat avelim uvirkat chatanim (vechulei). may birkat avelim? birkat rechava. deamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: birkat avelim baasara, veen avelim min hamminyan. birkat chatanim baasara, vachatanim min hamminyan.
Veen mezammenin al hammazon bashshem pachot measara (vechulei). kevan devae lememar "nevarech lelohenu" — betzir measara lav orach ara.
Vehakkarkaot tisha vechohen, veadam kayyotze bahen (vechulei). mena hane mille?
Amar shemuel: asara kohanim ketuvim bapparasha. chad legufeh, (vechad lemaote,) veiddach have miut achar miut, veen miut achar miut ella lerabbot. tisha yisreelim vechad kohen.
Veema: chamishsha kohanim vachamishsha yisreelim! kashya.
Veadam kayyotze bahen. adam mi kadosh?
Amar rabbi avahu: beomer "deme alay". detanya: haomer "deme alay" — shamin oto keeved. veeved ittakkash lekarkaot, dichtiv: "vehitnachaltem otam livnechem acharechem lareshet achuzza".
Mishna hakkore betora — lo yifchot mishshelosha pesukim, velo yikra limturegman yoter mippasuk echad.

a: Uvannavi shelosha. hayu shelashtan shalosh parashiyyot — korin echad echad.
Medallegin bannavi veen medallegin battora. vead kamma hu medalleg? ad kede shello yifsok hameturegman.
Gemara hane shelosha pesukin keneged mi? amar rav assi: keneged tora neviim uchetuvim.

Velo yikra lammeturegman yoter mippasuk echad, uvannavi — shelosha pesukim, veim hayu shelashtan shalosh parashiyyot — kore echad echad. kegon: "ki cho amar Adonai chinnam nimkartem". "ki ko amar Adonai elohim mitzrayim yarad ammi varishona", "veatta ma li fo neum Adonai".
Medallegin bannavi veen medallegin battora. ureminhi: kore "achare mot" veach beasor" — veha ka medalleg!
Amar abbaye, la kashya: kan bichde sheyyifsok hatturegman, vechan bichde shello yifsok hatturegman.
Veha ala katane: medallegin bannavi veen medallegin battora, vead kamma hu medalleg — ad kede shello yifsok hatturegman. michlal devattora kelal kelal la!
Ella amar abbaye, la kashya: kan beinyan echad, kan bishte inyaynot. vehatanya: medallegin battora beinyan echad, uvannavi bishne inyaynin. kan vechan, bichde shello yifsok hatturegman.
Tanya iddach: en medallegin minnavi lenavi, uvannavi shel shenem asar — medalleg, uvilvad shello yedalleg missof hassefer litchillato.
Mishna hammaftir bannavi — hu pores al shema, vehu over lifne hatteva, vehu nose et kappav. veim haya katan — aviv o rabbo ovrin al yado.
Katan kore battora umetargem. aval eno pores al shema, veeno over lifne hatteva, veeno nose et kappav.
Pocheach — pores et shema umetargem. aval eno kore battora, veeno over lifne hatteva, veeno nose et kappav.
Some — pores et shema umetargem. rabbi yehuda omer: kol shello raa meorot miyyamav — eno pores al shema.
Gemara may tama? rav pappa amar: mishshum kavod. rabba bar shimi amar: mishshum deate leinnetzoye.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deaved bechinnam.
Tenan: veim haya katan — aviv o rabbo ovrin al yado. i amrat mishshum [i]netzoye — katan bar [i]netzoye hu?
Ella may — mishshum kavod? katan bar kavod hu?! ella ikka kevod aviv uchevod rabbo,
b: Hacha name, ikka nitztzuye aviv venitztzuye rabbo.
Pocheach pores al shema vechulei. bea minneh ulla bar rav meabbaye: katan pocheach mahu sheyyikra battora?
Amar leh: vetibbee lach arom! arom may tama la — mishshum kevod tzibbur, hacha name mishshum kevod tzibbur.
Some pores al shema vechulei. tanya, amru lo lerabbi yehuda: harebe tzafu lidrosh bammerkava, velo rau otah mimehem.
Verabbi yehuda, hatam beovanta delibba talya milleta, veha ka mikkavven veyada. hacha mishshum hanaa hu, veha let leh hanaa.

Verabbanan — it leh hanaa, kerabbi yose. detanya, amar rabbi yose: kol yamay hayiti mitztaer al mikra ze: "vehayita memashshesh batztzohorayim kaasher yemashshesh haivver baafela", vechi ma ichpat leh leivver ben afela leora?
