Ad shebba maase leyadi: paam achat hayiti mehallech beishon layla vaafela, veraiti some shehaya mehallech badderech vaavuka beyado. amarti lo: beni, avuka zo lamma lach? amar li: kol zeman sheavuka beyadi, bene adam roin oti umatztzilin oti min happechatin umin hakkotzin umin habbarkanin.
Mishna kohen sheyyesh beyadav mumin lo yissa et kappav. rabbi yehuda omer: af mi shehayu yadav tzevuot setes lo yissa et kappav, mippene shehaam mistakkelin bo.

Gemara tana: mumin sheamru, befanav yadav veraglav. amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: yadav bohakaniyyot — lo yissa et kappav. tanya name hachi: yadav bohakaniyyot — lo yissa et kappav. akummot akushot — lo yissa et kappav.

Amar rav assi: chefani uveshani — lo yissa et kappav. tanya name hachi: en moridin lifne hatteva lo anshe bet shean velo anshe (bet) chefa velo anshe tivonin, mippene shekkorin laalfin ayynin velaayynin alfin.

Amar leh rabbi chiyyay lerabbi shimon bar rabbi: ilmale atta levi — pasul atta min hadduchan, mishshum daave kalach. ata amar leh laavu. amar leh: zil ema leh: kesheatta maggia etzel "vechikkiti laAdonai", lo nimtzet mecharef umegaddef?!

Amar rav huna: zavlegan lo yissa et kappav. veha hahu dahava beshivavuteh derav huna, vahava pares yedeh! hahu dash beiro hava. tanya name hachi: zavlegan lo yissa et kappav, veim haya dash beiro — muttar.

Amar rabbi yochanan: some beachat meenav — lo yissa et kappav. veha hahu dahava beshivavuteh derabbi yochanan dahava pares yedeh! hahu dash beiro hava. tanya name hachi: some beachat meenav — lo yissa et kappav, veim haya dash beiro — muttar.
Rabbi yehuda omer: mi shehayu yadav tzevuot — lo yissa et kappav. tana: im rov anshe hair melachtan bechach — muttar.
Mishna haomer: eni over lifne hatteva bitzvuin — af bilvanim lo yaavor. besandal eni over — af yachef lo yaavor.
Haose tefillato agulla — sakkana, veen bah mitzva. netanah al mitzcho o al pas yado — hare zo derech hamminut. (tzippan) [tzippah] zahav unetanah al bet unekli shello — hare zo derech hachitzonim.
Gemara may tama — chayyshinan shemma minut nizreka bo.
Haose tefillato agulla sakkana veen bah mitzva. lema tenena leha detanu rabbanan, tefillin merubbaot halacha lemoshe missinay! veamar rava: betifran uvaalachsonan!
Amar rav pappa: matnitin daavida ki amguza.
Mishna haomer:

a: "Yevarchucha tovim" — hare zo derech hamminut. "al kan tzippor yaggiu rachamecha", veal tov yizzacher shemecha", "modim modim" — meshattekin oto.
Hamechanne baarayot — meshattekin oto. haomer: "'umizzaracha lo titten lehaavir lammolech, lo titten leabara bearmayuta" — meshattekin oto binzifa.

Gemara bishlama "modim modim" — demichaze kishte rashuyot. "veal tov yizzacher shemecha" name, demashma: al tov — in, veal ra — la, utenan: chayyayv adam levarech al haraa keshem shehu mevarech al hattova. ella: "al kan tzippor yaggiu rachamecha" may tama?

Peligi ba tere amorae bemareva: rabbi yose bar avin verabbi yose bar zevida, chad amar: mippene shemmetil kina bemaase vereshit, vechad amar: mippene sheose middotav shel hakkadosh baruch hu rachamim, veenan ella gezerot.

Hahu dinchet kammeh derabba, amar: atta chasta al kan tzippor — atta chus verachem alenu! (atta chasta al "oto veet beno" — atta chus verachem alenu.) amar rabba: kamma yada hay merabbanan leratztzoye lemareh. amar leh abbaye: veha "meshattekin oto" tenan!
Verabba, lechaddode leabbaye hu diva.
Hahu dinchet kammeh derabbi chanina, amar: "hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora haaddir vehechazak vehaammitz".

Amar leh: sayyemtinhu lishvacheh demarach? hasheta hane telata, i lav dechatvinhu moshe beorayyta, vaato keneset haggedola vetakkeninhu — anan la amrinan lehu. veat amrat kulle hay! mashal leadam shehayu lo elef alfe alafim dinre zahav, vehayu mekallesin oto (beelef) dinre chesef. lo genay hu lo?!
Amar rabbi chanina: hakkol bide shamayim chutz miyyirat shamayim, shenneemar: "veatta yisrael ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach ki im leyira".

Mikkelal deyira milleta zutarti hi?! in, legabbe moshe rabbenu milleta zutarti hi. mashal leadam shemmevakkeshin hemennu keli gadol veyesh lo — dome alav kichli katan. katan veen lo — dome alav kichli gadol.
Amar rabbi zera: haomer "shema shema" — keomer "modim modim" dame.
Metivi: hakkore et shema vechoflah — hare ze megunne. megunne hu dehave, shattoke la meshattekinan leh?! la kashya: ha deamar milleta milleta vetane la, ha deamar pesuka pesuka vetane le.
Amar leh rav pappa lerava: vedilma meikkara la kavven dateh vehasheta kavven dateh? amar leh: chavruta kelappe shemayya? i la mechavven dateh, machena leh bearzafta denappacha ad dimchavven dateh.
Hamechanne baarayot meshattekin oto. tane rav yosef: kelon aviv ukelon immo.
Haomer: "umizzaracha lo titten lehaavir vechulei". tana deve rabbi yishmael: beyisrael habba al haggoya veholid mimmenna ben laavoda zara hakkatuv medabber.

Mishna maase reuven — nikra velo mittargem. maase tamar — nikra umittargem. maase egel harishon — nikra umittargem, vehashsheni — nikra velo mittargem. birkat kohanim, maase david veamnon — nikrain velo mittargemin.
En maftirin bammerkava, verabbi yehuda mattir. rabbi eliezer omer: en maftirin behoda et yerushalami".
Gemara tanu rabbanan: yesh nikrin umittargemin, veyesh nikrin velo mittargemin, veyesh lo nikrin velo mittargemin. ellu nikrin umittargemin. bala"400 aka"50 nishpe"5 siman.
Maase vereshit nikra umittargem. peshita! mahu detema: atu leshayyole ma lemala ma lematta,
b: Uma lifnim uma leachor, ka mashma lan.
Maase lot ushete venotav nikra umittargem. peshita! mahu detema: nechush lichvodo deavraham, ka mashma lan.
Maase tamar vihuda nikra umittargem. peshita! mahu detema: lechush lichvodo dihuda, ka mashma lan shevacheh hu deodi.
Maase egel harishon nikra umittargem. peshita! mahu detema: lechush lichvodan shel yisrael, ka mashma lan: kol shekken denicha lehu, dehavya lehu kappara.
Kelalot uverachot nikrin umittargemin. peshita! mahu detema: nechush dilma payyga datayyhu detzibbura, ka mashma lan.
Azharot vaonashin nikrin umittargemin. peshita! mahu detema: nechush dilma atu lemebad miyyira, ka mashma lan.
Maase amnon vetamar nikra umittargem [maase avshalom nikra umittargem]. peshita! mahu detema: lechush likareh dedavid, ka mashma lan.
Maase pilegesh baggiva nikra umittargem. peshita! mahu detema: lechush lichvodo devinyamin, ka mashma lan.

"Hoda et yerushalam et toavoteha" nikra umittargem. peshita! leappoke midderabbi eliezer. detanya: maase beadam echad shehaya kore lemala merabbi eliezer "hoda et yerushalam et toavoteha". amar lo: ad sheatta bodek betoavot yerushalayim tze uvedok betoavot immecha. badku acharav umatzu bo shemetz pesul.

Veellu nikrin velo mittargemin, (raabad"50 siman) maase reuven nikra velo mittargem. umaase berabbi chanina ben gamliel shehalach lechavul, vehaya kore chazzan hakkeneset "vayhi bishkon yisrael", veamar lo lammeturegman: (hafesek) al tetargem ella acharon, veshibbechuhu chachamim.
Maase egel hashsheni nikra velo mittargem. eze maase egel hashsheni — min "vayyomer moshe" ad "vayyar moshe".
Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: leolam yehe adam zahir bitshuvotav, shemmittoch teshuva sheheshivo aharon lemoshe pakru hamminin, shenneemar: "vaashlichehu vaesh vayyetze haegel hazze".
Birkat kohanim nikrin velo mittargemin. may tama? mishshum dichtiv: "yissa".
Maase david veamnon lo nikrin velo mittargemin. veha amrat maase amnon vetamar nikra umittargem! la kashya: ha dichtiv "amnon ben david", ha dichtiv "amnon" setama.

Tanu rabbanan: kol hammikraot hakketuvin battora lignay — korin otan leshevach, kegon: "yishgalenna" — yishkavenna, "baafolim" — battechorim, "chiryonim" — divyonim, "leechol et chorehem velishtot et meme shinnehem" — leechol et tzoatam velishtot et meme raglehem.
"Lemacharaot" — lemotzaot, rabbi yehoshua ben korcha omer: "lemacharaot" kishman, mippene shehu genay laavoda zara.

Amar rav nachman: kol letzanuta asira, bar milletzanuta daavoda zara — desharya. dichtiv: "kara bel kores nevo", uchetiv: "karsu charu yachdav lo yachlu mallet massa vegomer". rabbi yannay amar, mehacha: "leeglot bet aven yaguru shechan shomron ki aval alav ammo uchemarav alav yagilu al kevodo ki gala mimmennu". al tikre "kevodo", ella "kevedo".

Amar rav huna bar manoach mishshemeh derav acha bereh derav ika: shere leh levar yisrael lememar leh legoy: shikleh laavoda zara veannecheh beshin tav shello. amar rav ashe: hay man disne shumeaneh — shere leh levazzoyeh begimel veshin, hay man deshappir shumeaneh — shere leshabbocheh, uman deshabbecheh — yanuchu lo berachot al rosho.
Hadaran alach hakkore et hammegilla omed
Bene hair shemmachru rechovah shel ir — lokchin bedamav bet hakkeneset. bet hakkeneset — lokchin teva. teva — lokchin mitpachot. mitpachot —

a: Yikchu sefarim. sefarim — lokchin tora.
Aval im machru tora — lo yikchu sefarim. sefarim — lo yikchu mitpachot. mitpachot — lo yikchu teva. teva — lo yikchu bet hakkeneset. bet hakkeneset — lo yikchu et harchov.
Vechen bemotrehen.
Gemara bene hair shemmachru rechovah shel ir. amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: zo divre rabbi menachem bar yose setivmtaa, aval chachamim omrim: harchov en bo mishshum kedushsha.
Verabbi menachem bar yose, may tameh? hoil vehaam mitpallelin bo betaaniyyot uvemaamadot. verabbanan — hahu akray bealma.

Bet hakkeneset — lokchin teva. amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: lo shanu ella bet hakkeneset shel kefarim, aval bet hakkeneset shel kerakkin, kevan demealma atu leh — la matzu mezabbeni leh, dehave leh derabbim.
Amar rav ashe: hay be chenishta demata machseya, af al gav demealma atu la, kevan deaddata didi kaatu — i baena mezabbenna la.

Metivi, amar rabbi yehuda: maase bevet hakkeneset shel turesiyyim shehaya birushalayim shemmecharuha lerabbi eliezer veasa bah kol tzerachav, veha hatam dichrakkim hava! hahi, be chenishta zute hava, veinhu avdu.
Metivi: "bevet eretz achuzzatchem", achuzzatchem mittamma bingaim, veen yerushalayim mittamma bingaim. amar rabbi yehuda: ani lo shamati ella mekom mikdash bilvad.
Ha batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot mittammein, ammay? ha dichrakkin havu! ema, amar rabbi yehuda: ani lo shamati ella mekom mekuddash bilvad.
Bemay kamippalgi? tanna kamma savar: lo nitchalleka yerushalayim lishvatim, verabbi yehuda savar: nitchalleka yerushalayim lishvatim.
Uviflugeta dehane tannae.
Detanya: ma haya bechelko shel yehuda — har habbayit, halleshachot, vehaazarot. uma haya bechelko shel binyamin — ulam, vehechol, uvet kodshe hakkodashim.

Uretzua hayta yotzet mechelko shel yehuda venichneset bechelko shel binyamin, uvah mizbeach banuy, vehaya binyamin hatztzaddik mitztaer aleha bechol yom levolah, shenneemar: "chofef alav kol hayyom", lefichach zacha binyamin venaasa ushepizchan lashshechina.

Vehay tanna savar lo nitchalleka yerushalayim lishvatim. detanya: en maskirim battim birushalayim, mippene sheenan shellahen. rabbi elazar (bar tzadok) omer: af lo mittot. lefichach, orot kadashim — baale ushepizin notlin otan bizroa.
Amar abbaye: shema minna orach ara lemishbak inash gulepa umashka beushepizeh.
Amar rava: lo shanu ella shello machru shiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair, aval machru shiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair, afillu
b: Lemishte beh shichra — shappir dame.
Ravina hava leh hahu tilla deve chenishta. ata lekammeh derav ashe, amar leh: mahu lemizree? amar leh: zil zavneh mishshiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair, vezare.

Rame bar abba hava ka vane be chenishta. hava hahi kenishta attika, hava bae lemisteray uleetoye livne ucheshure minna veayyole lehatam. yatev veka mibbaya leh ha derav chisda, deamar rav chisda: la listor be chenishta ad devane be chenishta achariti — hatam mishshum peshiuta, ki hay gavvna may? ata lekammeh derav pappa vaasar leh. lekammeh derav huna vaasar leh.
Amar rava: hay be chenishta, challofa vezabbona — shere, ogora umashkona — asir. may tama: bikdusheta kae.
Livne name, challofinhu vezabboninhu — shere, ozofinhu — asir. hane mille beattikata, aval bechadta[ta]1 — let lan ba.
Vaafillu leman deamar hazemana milleta hi, hane mille kegon haoreg beged lammet. aval hacha, ketavuy learig dame, velekka leman deamar.
Mattana, peligi ba rav acha veravina, chad asar, vechad share. man deasar: bemay tifka kedusheta?! uman deshare: i lav dahava leh hanaa minneh — la hava yahev leh, hadar have lay mattana kizvine.

Tanu rabbanan: tashmishe mitzva — nizrakin. tashmishe kedushsha — nignazin. veellu hen tashmishe mitzva: sukka, lulav, shofar, tzitzit. veellu hen tashmishe kedushsha: deloskeme sefarim, tefillin umezuzot, vetik shel sefer tora, venartik shel tefillin uretzuotehen.
Amar rava, meresh hava amena: hay kuresya, tashmish detashmish hu, ushere. kevan dachazena demotvi illaveh sefer tora, amena: tashmish kedushsha hu, vaasir.
Veamar rava, meresh hava amena: hay perisa, tashmish detashmish hu. kevan dachazena deayyfi leh umannechi sifra illaveh, amena: tashmish kedushsha hu, vaasir.
Veamar rava: hay tevuta deirfat, mibeda teva zutarti — shere, kuresyay — asir. veamar rava: hay perisa divla, lemibedeh perisa lesifre — shere, lechumeshin — asir.
Veamar rava: hane zevile dechummashe vekamtere desifre — tashmish kedushsha ninhu, venignazin. peshita! mahu detema: hane lav lechavod avidan, lenattore bealma avidi, ka mashma lan.

Hahu be chenishta (dihudae) [d]romae dahava petiach lehahu idderona dahava machet beh met, vahavo bau kahane lemeal letzalloye hatam. ato, amaru leh lerava. amar lehu: dallo tevuta otvuha, dehave leh keli etz heasuy lenachat, ucheli etz heasuy lenachat eno mekabbel tumea vechotzetz bifne hattumea.
Amaru leh rabbanan lerava: veha zimnin dimtalteli leh ki mannach sefer tora illaveh, vehave leh mittaltel male verekam! i hachi la efshar.
Amar mar zutera: mitpechot sefarim shebbalu — osin otan tachrichin lemet mitzva, vezo hi genizatan.

Veamar rava: sefer tora shebbala — gonzin oto etzel talmid chacham, vaafillu shone halachot. amar rav acha bar yaakov: uvichli cheres, shenneemar: "unetattam bichli chares lemaan yaamdu yamim rabbim".
(Veamar) rav pappi mishshemeh derava: mibbe chenishta leve rabbanan — shere, mibbe rabbanan leve chenishta — asir. verav pappa mishshemeh derava matni ippecha. amar rav acha:

a: Kevoteh derav pappe mistabbera, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: bet hakkeneset — muttar laasoto bet hammidrash. shema minna.

Darash bar kappara, may dichtiv: "vayyisrof et bet Adonai veet bet hammelech veet kol batte yerushalam veet kol bet gadol saraf baesh". "bet Adonai" — ze bet hammikdash. "bet hammelech" — ellu palterin shel melech. "veet kol batte yerushalam" — kemashmaan. "veet kol bet gadol saraf baesh" — rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi, chad amar: makom shemmegaddelin bo tora, vechad amar: makom shemmegaddelin bo tefilla.
Man deamar tora, dichtiv: "Adonai chafetz lemaan tzidko yagdil tora veyadir". uman deamar tefilla, dichtiv: "sappera na haggedolot asher asa elisha", veelisha daavad — berachame hu daavad.
Tistayyem derabbi yehoshua ben levi hu deamar makom shemmegaddelin bo tora, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: bet hakkeneset muttar laasoto bet hammidrash. shema minna.

Aval machru tora lo yikchu sefarim vechulei. ibbaya lehu: mahu limkor sefer tora yashan likkach bo chadash? kevan dela mealle leh — asur, o dilma: kevan delekka lealloye illuyay acharina — shappir dame?
Ta shema: aval machru tora lo yikchu sefarim. sefarim hu dela, ha tora betora — shappir dame. matnitin diavad. ki ka mibbaya lan, lechattechilla.
Ta shema: gollin sefer tora bemitpechot chummashin, vechummashin bemitpechot neviim uchetuvim. aval lo neviim uchetuvim bemitpechot chummashin, velo chummashin bemitpechot sefer tora.
Katane mihat: gollim sefer tora bemitpechot chummashin, mitpechot chummashin — in, mitpechot sefer tora — la.
Ema sefa: velo chummashin bemitpechot sefer tora. ha tora betora — shappir dame! ella meha lekka lemishma minna.
Ta shema: mannichin sefer tora al gabbe tora, vetora al gabbe chummashin, vechummashin al gabbe neviim uchetuvim. aval lo neviim uchetuvim al gabbe chummashin, velo chummashin al gabbe tora.
Hannacha kaamrat? shane hannacha, dela efshar. dei la tema hachi, michrach hechi karchinan? veha ka yatev dappa achavreh! ella kevan dela efshar — shere. hacha name, kevan dela efshar — shere.
Ta shema: deamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabban shimon ben gamliel: lo yimkor adam sefer tora yashan likkach bo chadash.
Hatam — mishshum peshiuta. ki kaamrinan: kegon dichtiv umannach leipperoke, may?
Ta shema, deamar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi meir: en mochrin sefer tora ella lilmod tora velissa ishsha.
Shema minna tora betora shappir dame. dilma shane talmud, shehattalmud mevi lide maase. ishsha name: "la tohu veraah lashevet yetzarah", aval tora betora — la.
Tanu rabbanan: lo yimkor adam sefer tora af al pi sheeno tzarich lo. yater al ken amar rabban shimon ben gamliel: afillu en lo ma yochal umachar sefer tora o bitto — eno roe siman beracha leolam.
Vechen bemotrehen. amar rava: lo shanu ella shemmachru vehotiru, aval gavu vehotiru — muttar.
Etiveh abbaye: bamma devarim amurim — shello hitnu, aval hitnu — afillu leduchesuseya muttar.
Hechi dame? illema shemmachru vehotiru, ki hitnu may have? ella sheggavu vehotiru. tama dehitnu, ha lo hitnu — la!
Leolam shemmachru vehotiru, vehachi kaamar: bamma devarim amurim — shello hitnu shiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair, aval hitnu shiva tove hair bemaamad anshe hair — afillu leduchesuseya name muttar.
Amar leh abbaye lehahu merabbanan dahava mesaddar matneyata kammeh derav sheshet: mi shemia lach merav sheshet may "duchesuseya"? amar leh, hachi amar rav sheshet: parasha demata.
Amar abbaye: hilkach, hay tzureba merabbanan dishmia leh milleta vela yada perusha, lishayyeyla (kammeh) [leman] dishchiach kamme(5) rabbanan, dela efshar dela shemia leh min gavra rabba.
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi meir: bene hair shehalchu leir acheret ufasku alehen tzedaka — notnin, ucheshehen bain, meviin otah immahen umefarnesin bah aniyye iran.

Tanya name hachi: bene hair shehalchu leir acheret ufasku alehen tzedaka — notnin, ucheshehen bain, meviin otah immahen. veyachid shehalach leir acheret ufasku alav tzedaka — tinnaten laaniyye otah hair.
Rav huna gezar taanita. al legabbeh rav chana bar chanilay vechol bene mateh, remo alayyhu tzedaka vihavu. ki bau lemete, amaru leh: nivtva lan mar venezil unefarnes ba anye matin.
Amar lehu, tenena: bamma devarim amurim — besheen sham
b: Chaver ir, aval yesh sham chaver ir — tinnaten lachaver ir. vechol shekken deanye didi vedidchu alay semichi.
Mishna en mochrin et shel rabbim leyachid, mippene shemmoridin oto mikkedushshato, divre rabbi meir. amru lo: im ken af lo meir gedola leir ketanna.
Gemara shappir kaamri leh rabbanan lerabbi meir! verabbi meir, meir gedola leir ketanna — meikkara kaddisha, hasheta name kaddisha. merabbim leyachid lekka kedushsha.
Verabbanan — i ikka lemechash, ki hay gavvna name ikka lemechash, mishshum "berov am haderat melech".

Mishna en mochrin bet hakkeneset ella al tenay, sheim yirtzu yachziruhu, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: mochrin oto mimkar olam, chutz mearbaa devarim: lemerchatz, ulevureski, litvila, ulevet hammayim. rabbi yehuda omer: mochrin otah leshem chatzer, vehallokeach — ma sheyyirtze yaase.
Gemara ulerabbi meir, hechi dayyri ba? ha havya la ribbit!
Amar rabbi yochanan: rabbi meir beshitat rabbi yehuda amarah, deamar: tzad echad beribbit muttar.
Detanya: hare shehaya noshe bachavero mane, veasa lo sadehu mecher, bizman shemmocher ochel perot — muttar, lokeach ochel perot — asur.

Rabbi yehuda omer: afillu lokeach ochel perot — muttar. veamar rabbi yehuda: maase bevaytos ben zonin sheasa sadehu mecher al pi rabbi elazar ben azarya, velokeach ochel perot haya. amru lo: mishsham reaya?! mocher ochel perot haya velo lokeach.
May benayyhu? tzad echad beribbit ikka benayyhu. mar savar: tzad echad beribbit muttar, umar savar: tzad echad beribbit asur.
Rava amar: dechulle alma tzad echad beribbit asur, vehacha ribbit al menat lehachazir ikka benayyhu. mar savar: ribbit al menat lehachazir muttar, umar savar: asur.
Vachachamim omrim mochrin oto mimkar olam vechulei. amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: muttar laadam lehashetin mayim betoch arba ammot shel tefilla.

Amar rav yosef: may ka mashma lan? tenena, rabbi yehuda omer: mochrin otah leshum chatzer, velokeach — ma sheyyirtze yaase. vaafillu rabbanan la kaamri ella bet hakkeneset, dikvia kedusheteh. aval arba ammot, dela kevia kedushetayyhu — la.
Tane tanna kammeh derav nachman: hammitpallel — marchik arba ammot umashtin, vehammashtin — marchik arba ammot umitpallel.
Amar leh: bishlama hammashtin marchik arba ammot umitpallel — tenena: kamma yarchik mehen umin hatztzoa, arba ammot.
Ella: hammitpallel marchik arba ammot umashtin lema li? i hachi, kaddeshtinhu lechullehu shevile dinhardea. teni: yishhe.

Bishlama mashtin yishhe kede hilluch arba ammot, mishshum nitzotzot. ella: mitpallel yishhe kede hilluch arba ammot, lema li? amar rav ashe: shekkol arba ammot tefillato sedura befiv, verachoshe merachashan sifvoteh.
Zalfa"50 siman.

Shaalu talmidav et rabbi zakkay: bamma heerachta yamim? amar lahem: miyyamay lo hishtanti mayim betoch arba ammot shel tefilla, velo kinniti shem lachaveri, velo bittalti kiddush hayyom. imma zekena hayta li, paam achat machra kippa shebberoshah vehevia li kiddush hayyom.
Tana: keshemmeta, hannicha lo shelosh meot garve yayin. keshemmet hu, hinniach levanav sheloshet alafim garve yayin.
Rav huna hava asar rita vekae kammeh derav, amar leh: may hay? amar leh: la hava li kiddusha, umashkanteh lehemyaynay veetay beh kiddusha. amar leh: yehe raava detittum beshirae.

Ki ikkallal rabba bereh, rav huna inish gutza hava, gena appureya. atyayn benateh vechallateh shalchan veshadyayn manayyhu aleh ad deittum beshirae. shema rav veikkefad, amar: may tama la amart li ki barechtaych: "vechen lemar".
Shaalu talmidav et rabbi elazar ben shammua: bamma heerachta yamim? amar lahem: miyyamay lo asiti kappendarya levet hakkeneset, velo pasati al rashe am kadosh, velo nasati kappay belo beracha.
Shaalu talmidav et rabbi perida: bamma heerachta yamim? amar lahem: miyyamay lo kedamani adam levet hammidrash,

a: Velo berachti lifne chohen, velo achalti mibbehema shello huremu mattenoteha.

Deamar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: asur leechol mibbehema shello huremu mattenoteha. veamar rabbi yitzchak: kol haochel mibbehema shello huremu mattenoteha, keillu ochel tevalim. velet hilcheta kevoteh.
Velo berachti lifne chohen,

Lememra dimalleyuta hi? veha amar rabbi yochanan: kol talmid chacham shemmevarech lefanav, afillu kohen gadol am haaretz — oto talmid chacham chayyayv mita, shenneemar: "kol mesanay ahavu mavet". al tikre "mesanay", ella "masniay".
Ki kaamar ihu, beshavin.
Shaalu talmidav et rabbi nechuneya ben hakkana: bamme heerachta yamim? amar lahem: miyyamay lo nitkabbadti biklon chaveri, velo alta al mittati killat chaveri, uvatteran bemamoni hayiti.

Lo nitkabbadti biklon chaveri — ki ha derav huna dare mara akkatpeh. ata rav chana bar chanilay veka dare minneh. amar leh: i regilat dedaret bemataych — deri, vei la, ityaykkore ana beziluta didach la nicha li.
Velo alta al mittati killat chaveri — ki ha demar zutera ki hava salek lefureyeh, amar: shere leh lechol man detzaaran.
Uvatteran bemamoni hayiti — deamar mar: iyyov vavtran bemamoneh hava, shehaya manniach peruta lachenvani mimmamoneh.

Shaal rabbi akiva et rabbi nechuneya haggadol (amar lo): bamme heerachta yamim? ato gauoze veka machu leh. selek, yetev aresha dedikla. amar leh, rabbi: im neemar "keves" lamma neemar "echad"? amar lehu: tzureba midderabbanan hu, shivkuhu.
Amar leh: "echad" — meyuchad shebbeedro.
Amar leh: miyyamay lo kibbalti mattanot, velo amadti al middotay, uvatteran bemamoni hayiti.

Lo kibbalti mattanot, ki ha derabbi elazar ki havo meshadderi leh mattanot mibbe nesia — la hava shakel. ki hava mezammeni leh — la hava azel, amar lehu: la nicha lechu deechye, dichtiv: "sone mattanot yichye". rabbi zera ki havo meshadderi leh mibbe nesia — la hava shakel. ki hava mezammeni leh — azel. amar: ityaykkore demityaykkeri bi.
Velo amadti al middotay — deamar rava: kol hammaavir al middotav — maavirin mimmennu kol peshaav, shenneemar: "nose avon veover al pesha". lemi nose avon — lemi sheover al pesha.

Shaal rabbi et rabbi yehoshua ben korcha: bamma heerachta yamim? amar lo: katzta bechayyay? amar lo: rabbi, tora hi velilmod ani tzarich. amar lo: miyyamay lo nistakkalti bidmut adam rasha. deamar rabbi yochanan: asur leadam lehistakkel betzelem demut adam rasha, shenneemar: "lule pene yehoshafat melech yehuda ani nose im abbit elecha veim erekka".
Rabbi elazar amar: enav kehot, shenneemar: "vayhi ki zaken yitzchak vattichhena enav merot", mishshum deistakkal beesav harasha.

Veha gerama leh? vehaamar rabbi yitzchak: leolam al tehi killat hedyot kalla beenecha, shehare avimelech killel et sara, venitkayyem bezarah, shenneemar: "hinne hu lach kesut enayim": al tikre "kesut", ella "kesiyyayt enayim"!
Ha veha gerama leh. rava amar, mehacha: "seet pene rasha lo tov".
Bishat petirato, amar lo: [rabbi] barcheni! amar lo: yehi ratzon shettaggia lachatzi yamay. ulechullehu la? amar lo: habbaim acharecha — behema yiru?!
Avu bar ihi uminyamin bar ihi, chad amar: tete li dela istakkali begoy, vechad amar: tete li dela avadi shuttafut bahade goy.

Shaalu talmidav et rabbi zera: bamma heerachta yamim? amar lahem: miyyamay lo hikpadti betoch beti, velo tzaadti bifne mi sheggadol mimmenni, velo hirharti bimvoot hametunnafot, velo halachti arba ammot belo tora uvelo tefillin, velo yashanti bevet hammidrash lo shenat keva velo shenat aray, velo sasti betakkalat chaveri, velo karati lachaveri (bachanichato), veamri la: (bachachinato).
Mishna veod amar rabbi yehuda: bet hakkeneset shecharav — en maspidin betocho, veen mafshilin betocho chavalim, veen porsin letocho metzudot, veen shotchin al gaggo perot, veen osin oto kappendarya,
Shenneemar: "vahashimmoti et mikdeshechem" — kedushshatan af keshehen shommin.
Alu bo asavim lo yitlosh, mippene ogmat nefesh.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: batte chenesiyyot en nohagin bahen kallut rosh. en ochlin bahen, veen shotin bahen,
b: Veen neotin bahem, veen metayyeylin bahem, veen nichnasin bahen bachamma mippene hachamma, uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim. veen maspidin bahen hesped shel yachid. aval korin bahen, veshonin bahen, umaspidin bahen hesped shel rabbim,
Amar rabbi yehuda: ematay — beyishshuvan, aval bechurebanan — mannichin otan veolin bahen asavim, velo yitlosh mippene ogmat nefesh.

Asavim man dechar shemayyhu? chassore michassera vehachi katane: umechabbedin otan umarbitzin otan kede shello yaalu bahen asavim. amar rabbi yehuda: ematay — beyishshuvan, aval bechurebanan — mannichin otan laalot. alu bahen asavim — lo yitlosh, mippene ogmat nefesh.
Amar rav assi: batte chenesiyyot shebbevavel, al tenay hen asuyin. veaf al pi chen, en nohagin bahen kallut rosh. umay nihu — cheshbonot.
Amar rav assi: bet hakkeneset shemmechashshevin bo cheshbonot — melinin bo et hammet. melinin salka datach? la saggi delav hachi? ella, lesof sheyyalinu bo met mitzva.
Veen neotin bahen. amar rava: chachamim vetalmidehem muttarin, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: may be rabbanan — beta derabbanan.

Veen nichnasin bahen bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim. ki ha deravina verav adda bar matna havo kayymi veshaali sheelta merava, ata zilcha demitra, ayyli leve chenishta amri: hay deayylinan leve chenishta lav mishshum mitra, ella mishshum dishmata baaya tzilluta keyoma deistana.

Amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: i itzterich leh leinish lemikre gavra mibbe chenishta, may? amar leh: i tzureba merabbanan hu — lema hilcheta, vei tanna hu — lema matnitin, vei kara hu — lema pesuka. vei la, lema leh leyanoka: ema li pesukaych. i name, nishhe pureta venekum.
Umaspidin bahen hesped shel rabbim. hechi dame hespeda derabbim? machve rav chisda: kegon hespeda dekae beh rav sheshet. machve rav sheshet: kegon hespeda dekae beh rav chisda.

Rafram aspeda lechalleteh beve chenishta, amar: mishshum yekara didi udemita atu kulleh alma. rabbi zera safdeh lehahu merabbanan beve chenishta, amar: i mishshum yekara didi, i mishshum yekara (dideh) demita, atu kulle alma.
Resh lakish safdeh lehahu tzureba merabbanan dishchiach beara deyisrael dahava tane hilchata beesrim vearba shurata, amar: vavy chasra ara deyisrael gavra rabba.
Hahu dahava tane hilcheta sifra vesifre vetosefta ushechev, ato vaamaru leh lerav nachman: lispedeh mar! amar: hechi nispedeh? he tzanna dimle sifre dachasar?!
Ta chazi ma ben takkife deara deyisrael lachaside devavel.
Tenan hatam: udeishtammash betaga — chalef. tane resh lakish: ze hammishtammesh bemi sheshshone halachot kitrah shel tora.

Veamar ulla: lishtammash inish beman detane arbea, vela lishtammash beman dematne arbea. ki ha deresh lakish hava azel beorcha meta urekma demayya, ata hahu gavra arkeveh akkatpeh veka meabbar leh. amar leh: keret? amar leh: karena. tenet? tanena arbaa sidre mishna. amar leh: pesalt lach arbea ture vetaanat bar lakish akkatpach?! shedi bar lakisha bemayya!
Amar leh: nicha li daashammeeh lemar. i hachi, gemor minni ha milleta deamar rabbi zera: benot yisrael hen hechemiru al atzman sheafillu root tippat dam kechardal yoshvot alav shiva nekiyyim.
Tana deve eliyyahu: kol hashshone halachot, muvetach lo shehu ben olam habba, shenneemar: "halichot olam lo", al tikre "halichot" ella "halachot".
Tanu rabbanan:

a: Mevattelin talmud tora lehotzaat hammet, ulehachnasat hakkalla. amru alav al rabbi yehuda berabbi ilay shehaya mevattel talmud tora lehotzaat hammet ulehachnasat hakkalla. bamme devarim amurim — besheen sham kol tzorko, aval yesh sham kol tzorko — en mevattelin.

Vechamma kol tzorko? amar rav shemuel bar inya mishshemeh derav: teresar alfe gavre, veshitta alfe shippure. veamri la: teresar alfe gavre, uminnayyhu shitta alfe shippure. ulla amar: kegon dechayytzi gavre meavulla ad sichra.
Rav sheshet amar: kintinatah kach netilatah. ma netinatah beshishshim ribbo, af netilatah beshishshim ribbo. hane mille leman dekare vetane, aval leman dematne — let leh shiura.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: bo uree kamma chavivin yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu, shebbechol makom sheggalu — shechina immahen. galu lemitzrayim — shechina immahen, shenneemar: "hanniglo nigleti levet avicha bihyotam bemitzrayim vegomer". galu levavel — shechina immahen, shenneemar: "lemaanchem shullachti vavela". veaf keshehen atidin liggael — shechina immahen, shenneemar: "veshav Adonai elohecha et shevutecha". "veheshiv" lo neemar, ella "veshav". melammed shehakkadosh baruch hu shav immahen mibben haggaliyyot.

Bevavel hecha? amar abbaye: beve kenishta dehutzal, uveve kenishta deshaf vitev" binhardea. vela tema hacha vehacha, ella zimnin hacha vezimnin hacha. amar abbaye: tete li, dechi merachaykna parsa, ayelna umetzallena hatam. avu dishmuel [velevi] havo yatvi bichnishta deshaf vitev binhardea. atay shechina, shemau kol rigsha [kamu unefaku.

Rav sheshet hava yatev beve kenishta deshaf vitev binhardea, atay shechina] vela nefak. ato malache hashsharet veka mevaatu leh. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, aluv vesheeno aluv, mi nidche mippene mi? amar lehu: shivkuhu.
"Vaehi lahem lemikdash meat", amar rabbi yitzchak: ellu batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot shebbevavel. verabbi elazar amar: ze bet rabbenu shebbevavel.

Daresh rava, may dichtiv: "Adonai maon atta hayita lanu", ellu batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot. amar abbaye: meresh havay garesna beveta umetzallena beve chenishta, kevan dishmait leha dekaamar david: "Adonai ahavti meon betecha", havay garesna beve chenishta.

Tanya, rabbi elazar hakkappar omer: atidin batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot shebbevavel sheyyikkavu beeretz yisrael, shenneemar: "ki ketavor beharim uchecharmel bayyam yavo", vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma tavor vecharmel shello bau ella lefi shaa lilmod tora, nikbaim beeretz yisrael, batte chenesiyyot uvatte midrashot shekkorin umarbitzin bahen tora — al achat kamma vechamma.

Daresh bar kappara, may dichtiv: "lamma teratztzedun harim gavnunnim", yatzta bat kol veamra lahem: lamma tirtzu din im sinay? kullechem baale mumim attem etzel sinay. ketiv hacha: "gavnunim", uchetiv hatam: "o gibben o dak". amar rav ashe: shema minna hay man dihir — baal mum hu.
En osin oto kappendarya may "kappendarya"? amar rava: kappendarya kishmah. may kishmah? keman deamar: addemakkefna addare, eul beha.
Amar rabbi avahu: im haya shevil meikkara — muttar.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: hannichnas al menat shello laasot kappendarya — muttar laasoto kappendarya. veamar rabbi chelbo amar rav huna: hannichnas levet hakkeneset lehitpallel — muttar laasoto kappendarya, shenneemar: "uvevo am haaretz lifne Adonai bammoadim habba derech shaar tzafon lehishtachavot yetze derech shaar negev".
Alu bo asavim — lo yitlosh, mippene ogmat nefesh. vehatanya: eno tolesh umaachil, aval tolesh umanniach! ki tenan name matnitin — tolesh umaachil tenan.

Tanu rabbanan: bet hakkevarot, en nohagin bahen kallut rosh. en marin bahen behema, veen molichin bahen ammat hammayim, veen melakketin bahen asavim. veim likket — sorfan bimkoman, mippene kevod metim.
Aheyay? illema assefa — kevan shessorfan bimkoman may kevod metim ikka? ella aresha.
Mishna rosh chodesh adar shechal lihyot bashshabbat, korin befarashat shekalim. chal lihyot betoch hashshabbat — makdimin lesheavar, umafsikin leshabbat acheret.
Bashsheniyya "zachor". bashshelishit para adumma. barviit "hachodesh hazze lachem". bachamishit chozrin lichsidran.
Lakkol mafsikin: berashe chodashim, bachanukka uvefurim, betaaniyyot uvemaamadot, uveyom hakkippurim.
Gemara tenan hatam: beechad baadar mashmiin al hashshekalim,
b: Veal hakkilayim.
Bishlama al hakkilayim — dizman zeria hi, ella al hashshekalim menalan?
Amar rabbi tavi amar rabbi yoshiyya, deamar kera: "zot olat chodesh bechodsho", amra tora: chaddesh vehave korban mitteruma chadasha.
Vechevan divnisan bae akrove mitteruma chadasha, kadminan vekarenan beechad baadar, ki hechi delayto shekalim lammikdash.

Keman — dela kerabban shimon ben gamliel. dei rabban shimon ben gamliel, haamar shete shabbatot, detanya: shoalin behilchot happesach kodem lefesach sheloshim yom. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: shete shabbatot.
Afillu tema rabban shimon ben gamliel, kevan deamar mar: bachamishsha asar bo shulechanot yoshvin bammedina uveesrim vachamishsha yoshvin bammikdash — mishshum shulechanot kadminan vekarenan.
May parashat shekalim? rav amar: "tzav et bene yisrael veamarta alehem et korbani lachmi". ushemuel amar: "ki tissa".

Bishlama leman deamar "ki tissa", hayeynu dekare la parashat shekalim — dichtiv ba "shekalim". ella leman deamar "et korbani lachmi", hacha midde "shekalim" ketivi hatam? in, tama may — kidrabbi tavi.
Bishlama leman deamar "tzav et bene yisrael" — mishshum dichtivi "korbanot" hatam, kidrabbi tavi. ella leman deamar "ki tissa", "korbanot" mi ketivi? shekalim laadanim ketivi!
Kidtane rav yosef: shalosh terumot hen. shel mizbeach lammizbeach, veshel adanim laadanim, veshel bedek habbayit levedek habbayit.
Bishlama leman deamar "ki tissa", hayeynu deshane hay rosh chodesh mishshear rashe chodashim,
Ella leman deamar "tzav et korbani", may shane? shane, deillu rashe chodashim karu shitta beinyayna deyoma vechad bidrosh chodesh, veillu haiddana — kullehu bidrosh chodesh.
Hanicha leman deamar leseder parashiyyot hu chozer.
Ella leman deamar leseder hafetarot hu chozer, ufarashta deyoma karenan, may shane?
Shane, deillu rashe chodashim karu shitta beinyayna deyoma vechad kare bidrosh chodesh, veillu haiddana — karu telata beinyayna deyoma, vearbea karu bidrosh chodesh.

Metivi: rosh chodesh adar shechal lihyot bashshabbat korin befarashat shekalim, umaftirin bihoyada hakkohen. bishlama leman deamar "ki tissa", hayeynu demaftirin bihoyada hakkohen — dedame leh, dichtiv: "kesef nafshot erko",
Ella leman deamar "et korbani lachmi", mi dame? dame, kidrabbi tavi.
Metivi: chal lihyot bapparasha hassemucha lah, ben millefaneha uven milleachareha — korin otah vechoflin otah.
Bishlama leman deamar "ki tissa" hayeynu demitreme behahu zimna.
Ella leman deamar "tzav ... et korbani", mi mitreme behahu zimna? in — livne mareva demasseki lidorayyta bitlat shenin.
Tanya kevoteh dishmuel: rosh chodesh adar shechal lihyot beshabbat, korin "ki tissa" umaftirin bihoyada hakkohen.

Amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha: rosh chodesh adar shechal lihyot bashshabbat — motziin shalosh torot, vekorin bahen echad beinyayno shel yom, veechad beshel rosh chodesh, veechad bechi tissa". veamar rabbi yitzchak nappacha: rosh chodesh tevet shechal lihyot bashshabbat — meviin shalosh torot, vekorin bahen echad beinyayno shel yom, veechad bidrosh chodesh, veechad bachanukka.
Utzericha, dei ittemar beha — beha kaamar rabbi yitzchak, aval behach — kerav sevira leh, deamar parashat shekalim "et korbani lachmi", uvishte torot saggi, ka mashma lan.
Velema ha vela baaya hach! chada mikkelal chavertah ittemar.
Ittemar: rosh chodesh tevet shechal lihyot bachol, amar rabbi yitzchak: karu telata berosh chodesh, vechad bachanukka. verav dimi demin chefa amar: karu telata bachanukka, vechad berosh chodesh.
Amar rabbi mani: kevoteh derabbi yitzchak nappacha mistabbera, detadir vesheeno tadir tadir kodem.
Amar rabbi avin: kevoteh derav dimi mistabbera, mi garam larvii sheyyavo — rosh chodesh, hilkach revii berosh chodesh bae mikre.
May have ala? rav yosef amar: en mashgichin berosh chodesh, verabba amar: en mashgichin bachanukka, vehilcheta: en mashgichin bachanukka, verosh chodesh ikkar.
Ittemar: chal lihyot bivatta tetzavve", amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha: karu shitta mivveatta tetzavve" ad "ki tissa", vechad mikki tissa" ad "veasita". amar abbaye:

a: Amri: okome hu deka mokmi hatam.
Ella amar abbaye: karu shitta mivveatta tetzavve" ad "veasita", vechad tane vekare mikki tissa" ad "veasita".
Metivi: chal lihyot bapparasha hassemucha lah, ben millefaneha ben milleachareha — korin otah vechoflin otah.
Bishlama leabbaye nicha, ella lerabbi yitzchak nappacha kashya!
Amar lach rabbi yitzchak nappacha: uleabbaye mi nicha? tinach lefaneha, leachareha hechi mashkachat la?
Ella may it lach lememar: koflah beshabbatot, hacha name koflah beshabbatot.
Chal lihyot bechi tissa" atzmah, amar rabbi yitzchak nappacha: karu shitta min "veasita" ad "vayyakhel", vechad kare mikki tissa" ad "veasita".
Matkef la abbaye: hasheta amri lemafrea hu dekare! ella amar abbaye: karu shitta ad "vayyakhel", vechad tane vekare mikki tissa" ad "veasita".
Tanya kevoteh deabbaye: chal lihyot bechi tissa" atzmah — korin otah vechoflin otah.
Chal lihyot betoch hashshabbat — makdimin lashshabbat sheavra. ittemar: rosh chodesh adar shechal lihyot beerev shabbat, rav amar: makdimin, ushemuel amar: meacharin.
Rav amar makdimin — deim ken batzri lehu yome shulechanot. ushemuel amar meacharin — amar lach: sof sof chamesar bemaale shabbeta mikkela, veshulechanot la nafki ad chad beshabba, hilkach meacharin.
Tenan: chal lihyot betoch hashshabbat — makdimin lesheavar, umafsikin leshabbat acheret. may lav afillu beerev shabbat? lo, betoch hashshabbat davka.

Ta shema: ezo hi shabbat rishona — kol shechal rosh chodesh adar lihyot betochah, vaafillu beerev shabbat. may lav: afillu beerev shabbat — dumeya detochah, ma tochah makdimin — af erev shabbat makdimin!
Amar shemuel: bah. vechen tana deve shemuel: bah.

Ketannae: mesargin leshabbatot, divre rabbi yehuda hannasi. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: en mesargin. amar rabbi shimon ben elazar: ematay ani omer en mesargin — bizman shechal lihyot beerev shabbat, aval bizman shechal lihyot betoch hashshabbat — makdim vekore mishshabbat sheavra, af al pi shehu shevat.
Bishniyyay "zachor" vechulei. ittemar: purim shechal lihyot beerev shabbat, rav amar: makdimin parashat zachor, ushemuel amar: meacharin.
Rav amar makdimin — ki hechi dela tikdom asiyya lizchira. ushemuel amar meacharin — amar lach: kevan deikka mukkafin deavdi bachamesar, asiyya uzechira bahade hadade ka atyayn.
Tenan: bashsheniyya "zachor". veha ki mikkela resh yarcha beshabbat, mikkela purim beerev shabbat, vekatane bashsheniyya "zachor"! amar rav pappa: may sheniyya — sheniyya lehafesaka.
Ta shema: ezo shabbat sheniyya — kol shechal purim lihyot betochah, vaafillu beerev shabbat. may lav: erev shabbat — dumeya detochah, ma tochah makdimin — af erev shabbat makdimin!
Amar shemuel: bah. vechen tana deve shemuel: bah.

Chal lihyot beshabbat atzmah, amar rav huna: ledivre hakkol en makdimin. verav nachman amar: adayin hi machloket. ittemar name, amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba, amar rabbi abba amar rav: purim shechal lihyot beshabbat — makdim vekore bashshabbat sheavra "zachor".
Bashshelishit para adumma vechulei. tanu rabbanan: ezo hi shabbat shelishit — kol shessemucha lefurim meachareha. ittemar, rabbi chama berabbi chanina amar: shabbat hassemucha lerosh chodesh nisan.
Vela peligi: ha deikkela rosh chodesh nisan beshabbat, ha deikkela beemtza shabbat.

Barviit "hachodesh hazze lachem". tanu rabbanan: rosh chodesh adar shechal lihyot bashshabbat — korin "ki tissa", umaftirin bihoyada". vei zo hi shabbat rishona — kol shechal rosh chodesh adar lihyot betochah, vaafillu beerev shabbat. bashsheniyya "zachor", umaftirin "pakadti". vei zo hi shabbat sheniyya — kol shechal purim lihyot betochah, vaafillu beerev shabbat.

Bashshelishit para adumma, umaftirin "vezarakti alechem". vee zo hi shabbat shelishit — kol shessemucha lefurim meachareha. barviit hachodesh hazze, umaftirin "ko amar Adonai [elohim] barishon beechad lachodesh".
b: Veezo hi shabbat reviit — kol shechal rosh chodesh nisan lihyot betochah, vaafillu beerev shabbat.
Bachamishit chozrin lichsidran vechulei. leseder may? rabbi amme amar: leseder parashiyyot hu chozer. rabbi yirmeya amar: leseder hafetarot hu chozer.
Amar abbaye: kevoteh derabbi amme mistabbera, ditnan: lakkol mafsikin, lerashe chodashim, lachanukka, ulefurim, letaaniyyot, ulemaamadot, uleyom hakkippurim.
Bishlama leman deamar: leseder parashiyyot hu chozer — hayeynu deikka parasha bechol. ella leman deamar: leseder hafetarot hu chozer — hafetara bechol mi ikka?
Veiddach — ha kidita veha kidita.
Uvetaaniyyot lema li hafesaka? likre mitztzafra beinyana deyoma, uvemincha betaanita! mesayyay leh lerav huna, deamar rav huna: mitztzafra kinnufeya.

Hechi avdinan? amar abbaye: mitztzafra lefalgeh deyoma meayyeyninan bemille demata. mippalgeh deyoma lefanya, riva deyoma karu umafteri, veriva deyoma bau rachame, shenneemar: "vayyikreu besefer torat Adonai elohehem reviit hayyom ureviit (hayyom) mitvavdim umishtachavim".
Veefoch ana? la salka datach, dichtiv: "veelay yeasfu kol chared bedivre elohe yisrael al maal haggola vaani yoshev meshomem ad leminchat haarev", uchetiv: "uveminchat haerev kamti mittaaniti".

Mishna bappesach korin befarashat moadot shel torat kohanim. baatzeret — "shiva shavuot". berosh hashshana — "bachodesh hashshevii beechad lachodesh". beyom hakkippurim — "achare mot". beyom tov harishon shel chag korin befarashat moadot shebbetorat kohanim, uvishar kol yemot hachag bekorbenot hachag.
Bachanukka — bannesiim. bappurim — "vayyavo amalek". berashe chodashim — "uverashe chodshechem". bemaamadot — bemaase vereshit. betaaniyyot —

a: Berachot ukelalot. en mafsikin biklalot, ella echad kore et kullan.
Besheni uvachamishi, bashshabbat bammincha — korin kesidran, veen olim lahem min hacheshbon.
Shenneemar: "vaydabber moshe et moade Adonai el bene yisrael", mitzvatan sheyyehu korin kol echad veechad bizmanno.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: befesach korin befarashat moadot umaftirin befesach gilgal, vehaiddana deikka tere yome, yoma kamma — befesach gilgal, ulemachar — befesach yoshiyyahu.
Ushear yemot happesach melakket vekore meinyano shel pesach. may hi? amar rav pappa: meapp"vo siman.
Yom tov haacharon shel pesach korin "vayhi beshallach", umaftirin "vaydabber david". ulemachar "kol habbechor", umaftirin "od hayyom".
Amar abbaye, vehaiddana nehug alma lemikre: meshach tora, kaddesh bechaspa, pesal bemadbera, shallach buchera.
Baatzeret "shiva shavuot", umaftirin bachavakkuk. acherim omrim: "bachodesh hashshelishi", umaftirin bammerkava. vehaiddana deikka tere yome, avdinan ketarvayyhu veifka.
Berosh hashshana: "bachodesh hashshevii", umaftirin: "haven yakkir li efrayim". veyesh omrim: "vaAdonai pakad et sara", umaftirin bechanna.
Vehaiddana deikka tere yome — yoma kamma keyesh omrim, limchar: "vehaelohim nissa et avraham", umaftirin "haven yakkir".
Beyom hakkippurim korin "achare mot", umaftirin "ki cho amar ram venissa". uvammincha korin baarayot umaftirin beyona.
Amar rabbi yochanan: kol makom sheatta motze gevurato shel hakkadosh baruch hu, atta motze invevtanuto. davar ze katuv battora, veshanuy banneviim, umeshullash bakketuvim.

Katuv battora: "ki Adonai elohechem hu elohe haelohim vaadone haadonim", uchetiv batreh: "ose mishpat yatom vealmana". shanuy banneviim: "cho amar ram venissa shochen ad vekadosh vegomer", uchetiv batreh: "veet dakka ushefal ruach", meshullash bakketuvim, dichtiv: "sollu larochev baaravot beyah shemo", uchetiv batreh: "avi yetomim vedayyayn almanot".

Yom tov harishon shel chag korin befarashat moadot shebbetorat kohanim, umaftirin "hinne yom ba laAdonai". vehaiddana deikka tere yome, limchar mikra hachi name karenan, aftore may maftirin — "vayyikkahalu el hammelech shelomo".

Ushear kol yemot hachag korin bekorbenot hechag. yom tov haacharon korin "kol habbechor", mitzvot vechukkim uvechor, umaftirin "vayhi kechallot shelomo". lemachar korin "vezot habberacha", umaftirin "vayyaamod shelomo".
Amar rav huna amar rav: shabbat shechal lihyot bechullo shel moed, ben bappesach, ben bassukkot — mikra karenan "ree atta". aftore, bappesach — "haatzamot hayyeveshot". uvassukkot — "beyom bo gog".
Bachanukka — bannesiim, umaftirin benerot dizcharya. vei mikkali shete shabbatot — kammayyta benerot dizcharya, batrayyta benerot shelomo.

Bappurim — "vayyavo amalek". berashe chodashim — "uverashe chodshechem". rosh chodesh shechal lihyot beshabbat, maftirin "vehaya midde chodesh bechodsho". chal lihyot beechad bashshabbat, meetmol maftirin "vayyomer lo yehonatan machar chodesh".
Amar rav huna:
b: Rosh chodesh av shechal lihyot beshabbat, maftirin "chodshechem umoadechem sana nafshi hayu alay latorach". may "hayu alay latorach"? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: lo dayyayn lahem leyisrael shechotin lefanay, ella shemmatrichin oti leda ezo gezera kasha avi alehem.

Betisha beav gufeh may mafterinan? amar rav: "echa hayta lezona". mikra may? tanya, acherim omrim: "veim lo tishmeu li", rabbi natan bar yosef omer: "ad ana yenaatzuni haam hazze", veyesh omrim: "ad matay laeda haraa hazzot". amar abbaye: haiddana nehug alma lemikre "ki tolid banim", umaftirin "asof asifem".
[Bemaamadot] bemaase vereshit vechulei. menahane mille? amar rabbi amme: ilmale maamadot lo nitkayyeymu shamayim vaaretz, shenneemar: "im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti".

Uchetiv: "vayyomar Adonai elohim bamma eda ki irashenna", amar avraham lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, shemma chas veshalom yisrael chotim lefanecha veatta ose lahem kedor hammabbul uchedor happelagga? amar lo: lav.

Amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, "bamme eda"? amar lo: "kecha li egla meshulleshet vegomer". amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, tinach bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym. bizman sheen bet hammikdash kayyaym ma tehe alehem? amar lo: kevar tikkanti lahem seder korbanot, kol zeman shekkorin bahen maale ani alehen keillu makrivin lefanay korban, umochel ani al kol avonotehem.
Betaaniyyot berachot ukelalot, veen mafsikin bakkelalot. mena hane mille? amar rabbi chiyyay bar gammada amar rabbi assi: deamar kera "musar Adonai beni al timas".
Resh lakish amar: lefi sheen omrim beracha al happureanut: ella hechi aved? tana: keshehu matchil — matchil bappasuk shellifnehem, ucheshehu mesayyem — mesayyem bappasuk shelleacharehen.

Amar abbaye: lo shanu ella biklalot shebbetorat kohanim, aval kelalot shebbemishne tora — posek. may tama — hallalu bilshon rabbim amurot, umoshe mippi haggevura amaran, vehallalu bilshon yachid amurot, umoshe mippi atzmo amaran.
Levi bar bute hava kare veka megamgem kammeh derav huna baarure. amar lo: akkenafshach. lo shanu ella kelalot shebbetorat kohanim, aval shebbemishne tora — posek.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: ezra tikken lahen leyisrael sheyyehu korin kelalot shebbetorat kohanim kodem atzeret, veshebbemishne tora kodem rosh hashshana. may tama? amar abbaye veittema resh lakish: kede shettichle hashshana vekilloteha.
Bishlama shebbemishne tora, ikka kede shettichle shana vekilloteha. ella shebbetorat kohanim, attu atzeret rosh hashshana hi? in, atzeret name rosh hashshana hi. ditnan: uvaatzeret al perot hailan.

Tanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: im yomru lach zekenim "setor" viladim "bene" — setor veal tivne, mippene shessetirat zekenim binyan, uvinyan nearim setira. vesiman laddavar — rechavam ben shelomo.

Tanu rabbanan: makom shemmafsikin bashshabbat shacharit — sham korin bemincha, bemincha — sham korin besheni, besheni — sham korin bachamishi, bachamishi — sham korin lashshabbat habbaa, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: makom shemmafsikin bashshabbat shacharit — sham korin bemincha, uvashsheni uvachamishi, velashshabbat habbaa.
Amar rabbi zera: halacha, makom shemmafsikin bashshabbat shacharit — sham korin bemincha, uvesheni uvachamishi, velashshabbat habbaa. velema: halacha kerabbi yehuda!

a: Mishshum deafchi lehu.
Tanu rabbanan: poteach veroe, golel umevarech, vechozer ufoteach vekore. divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: poteach veroe umevarech vekore.
May tama derabbi meir? kidulla. deamar ulla: mippene ma amru hakkore battora lo yesayyea lamturegman — kede shello yomru targum katuv battora. hacha name: kede shello yomru berachot ketuvin battora.
Verabbi yehuda: targum — ikka lemite, berachot — lekka lemite.
Amar rabbi zera amar rav matna: halacha, poteach veroe umevarech vekore. velema: halacha kerabbi yehuda! mishshum deafchi lehu.
Amar rabbi zera amar rav matna: halluchot vehabbimot — en bahen mishshum kedushsha.
Amar rabbi shefatya amar rabbi yochanan: haggolel sefer tora — tzarich sheyyaamidennu al hattefer.
Veamar rabbi shefatya amar rabbi yochanan: haggolel sefer tora — gollo mibbachutz, veen gollo mibbifnim.
Ucheshehu mehaddeko — mehaddeko mibbifnim, veeno mehaddeko mibbachutz.

Veamar rabbi shefatya amar rabbi yochanan: asara shekkaru battora, haggadol shebbahem golel sefer tora. haggollo notel sechar kullan, deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: asara shekkaru battora, haggolel sefer tora kibbel sechar kullan. sechar kullan salka datach? ella ema: kibbel sachar keneged kullan.

Veamar rabbi shefatya amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin shemmishtammeshin bevat kol, shenneemar: "veoznecha tishmana davar meacharecha lemor". vehane mille, deshama kal gavra bemata, vekal itteta bedavra. vehu deamar: "hen hen" vehu deamar: "lav lav".
Veamar rabbi shefatya amar rabbi yochanan: kol hakkore belo neima veshone belo zimra, alav hakkatuv omer: "vegam ani natatti lahem chukkim lo tovim vegomer".

Matkef la abbaye: mishshum dela yada levassome kala — "mishpatim lo yichyu bahem" karet beh?! ella kidrav mesharsheya, deamar: shene talmide chachamim hayyoshvim beir achat veen nochin ze et ze bahalacha — alehem hakkatuv omer: "vegam ani natatti lahem chukkim lo tovim umishpatim lo yichyu bahem".
Amar rabbi parnach amar rabbi yochanan: kol haochez sefer tora arom, nikbar arom. arom salka datach? ella ema: nikbar arom belo mitzvot.
Belo mitzvot salka datach?! ella amar abbaye: nikbar arom belo otah mitzva.
Amar rabbi yannay bereh derabbi yannay sava mishshemeh derabbi yannay rabba: mutav tiggalel hammitpachat veal yiggalel sefer tora.

"Vaydabber moshe et moade Adonai el bene yisrael", mitzvatan sheyyihyu korin otan kol echad veechad bizmanno. tanu rabbanan: moshe tikken lahem leyisrael sheyyehu shoalin vedorshin beinyano shel yom. hilchot pesach — bappesach, hilchot atzeret — baatzeret, hilchot chag — bechag.
Hadaran alach bene hair uselika la massechet megilla
